common.processChangesModal.versionHeader.defaultMessage: Open a new version and save ground truth
common.processChangesModal.versionHeader.description: Title of the dialog shown before Process Changes on a test-set item's edit page while the test set has no draft version open.

common.processChangesModal.willDo.description: Text of the Confirm Reprocessing dialog before Save and Re-extract in Edit Page Grouping, above the list of what it does.

common.promptCache.counts.defaultMessage: {read, number} read · {written, number} written · {uncached, number} uncached input tokens
common.promptCache.counts.description: The token counts of a prompt-cache note, its whole detail or the start of it, on a phase's subtotal row in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page and in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {read} is the number of input tokens read from the cache, {written} the number written to it, and {uncached} the number of input tokens the cache did not cover.

common.promptCache.countsOverRequests.defaultMessage: {read, number} read · {written, number} written · {uncached, number} uncached input tokens over {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}
common.promptCache.countsOverRequests.description: The token counts of a prompt-cache note when the number of model requests is known, its whole detail or the start of it, on a phase's subtotal row in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page and in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {read} is the number of input tokens read from the cache, {written} the number written to it, {uncached} the number of input tokens the cache did not cover, and {requests} the number of model requests they add up over.

common.promptCache.detail.implicitCachin.defaultMessage: {counts}. This model caches implicitly, so no {marker} marker is required; a prefix seen again within the cache TTL is reported as caching once reads land.
common.promptCache.detail.implicitCachin.description: Detail of the prompt-cache note when no cache point was sent to a model that caches without one, in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {counts} is the note's token counts, such as "0 read · 0 written · 949 uncached input tokens". {marker} is the marker a prompt carries where its cached part ends, <<CACHEPOINT>>, shown as written. TTL is the cache's time to live.

common.promptCache.detail.neverCached.defaultMessage: {counts}. The prompt prefix is probably below {floor}; run "{command}" for the per-class estimate.
common.promptCache.detail.neverCached.description: Detail of the prompt-cache note when nothing was read from or written to the cache, in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {counts} is the note's token counts, such as "0 read · 0 written · 949 uncached input tokens". {floor} names the model's minimum cacheable prefix, such as "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4's minimum cacheable prefix of 1,024 tokens". {command} is the command-line check that gives that estimate, idp-cli config validate, shown as written.

common.promptCache.detail.neverCachedExt.defaultMessage: {counts}. Either no cache point reached the model for this phase (no {marker} marker, {setting}, or an unsupported model) or the prompt prefix is below {floor}.
common.promptCache.detail.neverCachedExt.description: Detail of the prompt-cache note when nothing was read from or written to the cache, on an extraction phase's subtotal row in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page. {counts} is the note's token counts, such as "0 read · 0 written · 949 uncached input tokens". {marker} is the marker a prompt carries where its cached part ends, <<CACHEPOINT>>, and {setting} the configuration setting that turns prompt caching off, extraction.prompt_cache: off; both are shown as written. {floor} names the model's minimum cacheable prefix, such as "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4's minimum cacheable prefix of 1,024 tokens".

common.promptCache.detail.neverCachedPha.defaultMessage: {counts}. Either no cache point reached the model for this phase or the prompt prefix is below {floor}.
common.promptCache.detail.neverCachedPha.description: Detail of the prompt-cache note when nothing was read from or written to the cache, on the subtotal row of a phase other than extraction in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page. {counts} is the note's token counts, such as "0 read · 0 written · 949 uncached input tokens". {floor} names the model's minimum cacheable prefix, such as "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4's minimum cacheable prefix of 1,024 tokens".

common.promptCache.detail.noCachePoint.defaultMessage: {counts}. The prompt has no {marker} marker, or this model is not one the client sends cachePoint blocks to.
common.promptCache.detail.noCachePoint.description: Detail of the prompt-cache note when no cache point was sent to the model, in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {counts} is the note's token counts, such as "0 read · 0 written · 949 uncached input tokens". {marker} is the marker a prompt carries where its cached part ends, <<CACHEPOINT>>, shown as written. cachePoint is the name of the block the Bedrock client adds to a request, kept as written.

common.promptCache.detail.writeOnly.defaultMessage: {counts}. Expected when a class is processed once per 5-minute TTL.
common.promptCache.detail.writeOnly.description: Detail of the prompt-cache note when tokens were written to the cache and none read from it, on the subtotal row of a phase other than extraction in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page. {counts} is the note's token counts, such as "0 read · 1,628 written · 9 uncached input tokens". TTL is the cache's time to live.

common.promptCache.detail.writeOnlyExtra.defaultMessage: {counts}. Expected when a class is processed once per 5-minute TTL; a low-volume deployment can set {setting}.
common.promptCache.detail.writeOnlyExtra.description: Detail of the prompt-cache note when tokens were written to the cache and none read from it, on an extraction phase's subtotal row in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page and in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {counts} is the note's token counts, such as "0 read · 1,628 written · 9 uncached input tokens". {setting} is the configuration setting that turns prompt caching off, extraction.prompt_cache: off, shown as written. TTL is the cache's time to live.

common.promptCache.floor.description: The part of a prompt-cache note that names the smallest prompt prefix the model will cache, when that size is not known; the never-cached details put it after "below" ("…or the prompt prefix is below {floor}." and "The prompt prefix is probably below {floor}; run …"). {models} is the model id, or several separated by commas, or "the model".

common.promptCache.floorWithMinimum.defaultMessage: {models}'s minimum cacheable prefix of {min, number} tokens
common.promptCache.floorWithMinimum.description: The part of a prompt-cache note that names the smallest prompt prefix the model will cache; the never-cached details put it after "below" ("…or the prompt prefix is below {floor}." and "The prompt prefix is probably below {floor}; run …"). {models} is the model id, or several separated by commas, or "the model". {min} is that size, in tokens.

common.promptCache.headline.caching.defaultMessage: Prompt cache: caching ({share, number, ::percent} of input read from cache)
common.promptCache.headline.caching.description: Headline of the prompt-cache note when input was read from the cache, beside a success icon, on a phase's subtotal row in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page and in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {share} is the share of the input read from the cache, as a percentage.

common.promptCache.headline.disabled.description: Headline of the prompt-cache note when the configuration turned prompt caching off, beside a stopped icon, in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {setting} is the configuration setting that does it, extraction.prompt_cache: off, shown as written.

common.promptCache.headline.implicitCach.defaultMessage: Prompt cache: implicit caching — no cache point needed
common.promptCache.headline.implicitCach.description: Headline of the prompt-cache note when no cache point was sent to a model that caches without one, beside an info icon, in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report.

common.promptCache.headline.neverCached.defaultMessage: Prompt cache: never cached — the cache point was inert
common.promptCache.headline.neverCached.description: Headline of the prompt-cache note when nothing was read from or written to the cache, beside a warning icon, on a phase's subtotal row in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page and in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report.

common.promptCache.headline.noCacheData.defaultMessage: Prompt cache: no cache usage reported by this model or backend
common.promptCache.headline.noCacheData.description: Headline of the prompt-cache note when the model or backend reported no cache usage at all, or a cache state the UI does not know, beside an info icon, in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report.

common.promptCache.headline.noCachePoint.defaultMessage: Prompt cache: no cache point reached the model
common.promptCache.headline.noCachePoint.description: Headline of the prompt-cache note when no cache point was sent to the model, beside an info icon, in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report.

common.promptCache.headline.writeOnly.defaultMessage: Prompt cache: write-only — paid 1.25× to write {written, number} tokens, no read landed
common.promptCache.headline.writeOnly.description: Headline of the prompt-cache note when tokens were written to the cache and none read from it, beside a warning icon, on a phase's subtotal row in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page and in the Processing Path of the edit page's Processing Report. {written} is the number of tokens written to the cache.

common.promptCache.theModel.description: Stands for the model in a prompt-cache note when the summary names no model id, as in "the model's minimum cacheable prefix".

common.reasonModal.cancel.description: Button of the dialog that asks why before a review action (such as Skip All Reviews): closes it and does nothing.

common.reasonModal.note.description: Label, and screen-reader name, of the free-text note in the dialog that asks why before a review action.

common.reasonModal.noteDescription.defaultMessage: Optional. Kept with the reason in the review history.
common.reasonModal.noteDescription.description: Help text of the Note field: a note is optional and is recorded with the reason in the review history.

common.reasonModal.noteTooLong.description: Error under the Note field when the note is too long. {max} is the most characters a note may have.

common.reasonModal.reason.description: Label, and screen-reader name, of the list of reasons in the dialog that asks why before a review action.

common.reasonModal.reasonPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the Reason list until a reason is chosen.

common.reasonModal.reasonRequired.description: Error under the Reason list when the review action was confirmed without a reason.

common.relativeTime.justNow.description: Relative time of something less than 45 seconds old, where older times read "5 minutes ago" or "yesterday".

common.reportModal.close.description: Button that closes a report dialog opened from the Reports menu of the document page or the edit page.

common.reviewStatus.inReviewQueue.canWor.defaultMessage: This document is in a review queue. Choose Edit to work on it there.
common.reviewStatus.inReviewQueue.canWor.description: Why an action of the document page is unavailable while the document waits in a review queue, for a user who works review queues: the page's Edit button opens its queue item.

common.reviewStatus.inReviewQueue.cannot.defaultMessage: This document is in a review queue. An Admin, Annotator or Reviewer reviews it there.
common.reviewStatus.inReviewQueue.cannot.description: Why an action of the document page is unavailable while the document waits in a review queue, for a user who does not work review queues.

common.reviewStatus.reason.downstreamQue.description: A reason in the Reason list of Send to review: a customer or a downstream system asked about the document.

common.reviewStatus.reason.duplicateDocu.description: A reason in the Reason list of Skip All Reviews and bulk skip: the document is a copy of another one.

common.reviewStatus.reason.otherSeeNote.description: A reason in the Reason list of Skip All Reviews, bulk skip and Send to review: another reason, written in the Note.

common.reviewStatus.reason.reviewNotNeed.defaultMessage: Review not needed for this document
common.reviewStatus.reason.reviewNotNeed.description: A reason in the Reason list of Skip All Reviews and bulk skip: the document needs no review.

common.reviewStatus.reason.spotCheck.description: A reason in the Reason list of Send to review: a finished document is checked at random.

common.reviewStatus.reason.suspectedExtr.description: A reason in the Reason list of Send to review: a value extracted from the document looks wrong.

common.reviewStatus.reason.valuesLookCor.description: A reason in the Reason list of Skip All Reviews and bulk skip: the document's extracted values look correct.

common.reviewStatus.state.claimed.description: State of a review queue item an Annotator holds. Shown on the item's edit page; the work tables say Assigned for it instead.

common.reviewStatus.state.complete.description: State of a review queue item whose review is done. Shown in a queue's Documents table and on the item's edit page.

common.reviewStatus.state.finalizeFailed.description: State of a review queue item whose review is done but whose result could not be applied to the document yet; it is retried. Shown in a queue's Documents table and on the item's edit page.

common.reviewStatus.state.finalizing.description: State of a review queue item whose review is done and whose result is being applied to the document. Shown in a queue's Documents table and on the item's edit page.

common.reviewStatus.state.holding.description: State of a review queue item that is being prepared and is not yet waiting for review. Shown in a queue's Documents table and on the item's edit page.

common.reviewStatus.state.open.description: State of a review queue item waiting in its queue for an Annotator to claim it or an Admin to assign it. Shown in a queue's Documents table and on the item's edit page.

common.reviewStatus.state.rejected.description: State of a review queue item whose document a reviewer rejected. Shown in a queue's Documents table and on the item's edit page.

common.reviewStatus.state.unknown.description: State label of a review queue item when no state is known for it.

common.reviewStatus.state.withdrawn.description: State of a review queue item taken out of review without a result, for example because its document was processed again. Shown in a queue's Documents table and on the item's edit page.

common.sectionGrouping.duplicateId.defaultMessage: Section id ''{id}'' is used by more than one section.
common.sectionGrouping.duplicateId.description: A problem shown on a section's column of the Edit Page Grouping board. {id} is the section id that more than one section uses.

common.sectionGrouping.noId.description: A problem with the grouping, listed in the alert above the Edit Page Grouping board.

common.sectionGrouping.noPages.defaultMessage: This section has no pages. Move a page into it, or delete the section.
common.sectionGrouping.noPages.description: A problem shown on a section's column of the Edit Page Grouping board while the section has no pages.

common.sectionGrouping.notInDocument.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Page {pageIds} not in this document.} other {Pages {pageIds} not in this document.}}
common.sectionGrouping.notInDocument.description: A problem shown on a section's column of the Edit Page Grouping board when the section holds pages the document does not have. {count} is how many; {pageIds} lists their numbers, separated by commas.

common.sectionGrouping.pageClaimed.description: A problem shown on a section's column of the Edit Page Grouping board when another section already holds one of its pages. {pageId} is the page's number; {sectionId} is the number of the section that holds it.

common.sectionGrouping.pagesNotInSection.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Page {pageIds} is not in any section. Every page has to belong to one.} other {Pages {pageIds} are not in any section. Every page has to belong to one.}}
common.sectionGrouping.pagesNotInSection.description: A problem with the grouping, listed in the alert above the Edit Page Grouping board, when pages of the document are in no section. {count} is how many; {pageIds} lists their numbers, separated by commas.

common.summaryReport.empty.defaultMessage: Summary report not available for this document
common.summaryReport.empty.description: Text of the Document Summary dialog when the document has no summary report.

common.summaryReport.title.description: Title of the dialog that shows the document's summary, opened from Reports › Summary on the document page or the edit page.

common.table.filterCount.description: Count next to a table's text filter. {count} is the number of rows the filter matches.

common.table.noData.description: Shown in a table that has no rows once loading has finished, where the table has no empty text of its own (a queue's Documents table, Review Management's Test Studio queues).

common.table.noMatch.body.description: Text under the heading a table shows when its filter matches no row.

common.table.noMatch.clear.description: Button under the no-match text of a table that clears its filter.

common.table.noMatch.title.description: Heading a table shows when its filter matches no row.

configPrefixMappings.history.action.crea.description: Change history: the mapping was created.

configPrefixMappings.history.action.dele.description: Change history: the mapping was deleted.

configPrefixMappings.history.action.upda.description: Change history: the mapping was edited.

configPrefixMappings.history.changed.des.description: Change history detail: the mapping’s free-text description was edited.

configPrefixMappings.history.changed.ena.description: Change history detail: the mapping was turned on or off. Each side is yes or no.

configPrefixMappings.history.changed.pre.description: Change history detail: the mapping’s conflict mode changed (mapping, metadata or reject).

configPrefixMappings.history.changed.pro.description: Change history detail: the mapping’s Configuration Profile changed from one name to another.

configPrefixMappings.history.changed.rev.description: Change history detail: the mapping’s revision changed. Each side is "published revision" or r7.

configPrefixMappings.history.col.change.description: Change history column header: whether the mapping was created, edited or deleted.

configPrefixMappings.history.col.details.description: Change history column header: what the change did to the mapping.

configPrefixMappings.history.col.mapping.description: Change history column header: the S3 prefix of the mapping that changed.

configPrefixMappings.history.col.when.description: Change history column header: when the change was made.

configPrefixMappings.history.col.who.description: Change history column header: the signed-in administrator who made the change.

configPrefixMappings.history.created.description: Change history detail for a created mapping. {profile} is a Configuration Profile name, {revision} is either "published revision" or r7, {precedence} is the conflict mode, for example "mapping wins".

configPrefixMappings.history.deleted.description: Change history detail for a deleted mapping: what it assigned before it was deleted.

configPrefixMappings.history.description.defaultMessage: Every create, edit and delete made to a mapping, newest first, with who made it. Changes to deleted mappings are kept.
configPrefixMappings.history.description.description: Explanation under the Change history header on the Prefix Mappings page.

configPrefixMappings.history.enabled.no.description: Change history: the mapping was disabled.

configPrefixMappings.history.enabled.yes.description: Change history: the mapping was enabled.

configPrefixMappings.history.filteredTo.description: Shown when the change history is narrowed to one mapping. {prefix} is the mapping prefix, for example acme/invoices/.

configPrefixMappings.history.header.description: Header of the collapsible section on the Prefix Mappings page that lists every change made to a mapping.

configPrefixMappings.history.link.description: Row action in the mappings table that opens the change history for that one mapping.

configPrefixMappings.history.linkAria.description: Screen-reader name of the History row action. {prefix} is the mapping prefix.

configPrefixMappings.history.loadFailed.defaultMessage: Failed to load the mapping history
configPrefixMappings.history.loadFailed.description: Error shown when the change history could not be read and the server gave no message.

configPrefixMappings.history.loadOlder.description: Button under the change history that fetches the next page of older changes.

configPrefixMappings.history.noFieldChan.defaultMessage: Saved with no change to its settings
configPrefixMappings.history.noFieldChan.description: Change history detail: the mapping was saved again with the same profile, revision, conflict mode and description.

configPrefixMappings.history.precedence..description: Change history: the conflict mode in which the mapping overrides a profile named by the upload.
Change history: the conflict mode in which a profile named by the upload overrides the mapping.
Change history: the conflict mode in which a conflicting upload is refused.

configPrefixMappings.history.published.description: Change history: the mapping follows its profile’s published revision rather than pinning one.

configPrefixMappings.history.revision.description: Change history: a pinned revision number of a Configuration Profile, for example r7.

configPrefixMappings.history.showAll.description: Button that removes the one-mapping filter from the change history.

configuration.layout.previewPrompts.description: Configuration page: label of the button that opens a dialog showing what each processing step's prompt includes, and the header of that dialog.

configuration.layout.previewPromptsClose.description: Button that closes the "Preview prompts" dialog of the Configuration page.

configuration.layout.previewPromptsDisab.description: Tooltip on the disabled "Preview prompts" button of the Configuration page, shown while no configuration profile is open.

configuration.toolsPanel.editingTabsAndP.defaultMessage: The Processing Settings tab holds the processing steps' settings (OCR, classification, extraction, assessment, summarization, HITL and the rest). Use the Document Schema and Policy Schema tabs to edit document classes and validation rules, and the Preview prompts button to see what each step's prompt includes, with your configuration values filled in. The preview shows which placeholders a step carries and which it leaves empty; it is not the exact bytes of the request.
configuration.toolsPanel.editingTabsAndP.description: Configuration info panel, "Editing" list item. Each <strong> phrase is the label of a tab or button on the Configuration page, shown in bold.

discovery.policyGroup.constraint.defaultMessage: Up to {maxLength} characters: letters, digits, spaces, underscores, hyphens and dots. Rules are added to the group, never replaced.
discovery.policyGroup.constraint.description: Constraint text under the policy group field. {maxLength} is the maximum length (64).

discovery.policyGroup.description.defaultMessage: Uploads with the same policy group add their rules to one policy class, so one regex matches them all. Use it for chapters of one manual. Leave empty to save this upload as its own policy class.
discovery.policyGroup.description.description: Help text of the policy group field on the Policy Discovery upload form.

discovery.policyGroup.invalidCharacters.defaultMessage: Policy group must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, spaces, underscores, hyphens and dots.
discovery.policyGroup.invalidCharacters.description: Validation error of a policy group name with characters that are not allowed.

discovery.policyGroup.label.description: Label of the optional policy group name field on the Policy Discovery upload form.

discovery.policyGroup.placeholder.description: Placeholder of the policy group field on the Policy Discovery upload form. Keep the example name untranslated.

discovery.policyGroup.replaceWithGroup.defaultMessage: A policy group cannot be used with Replace existing schema, because Replace removes every policy class in the profile, including the group, before discovery runs. Choose Add to existing schema, or clear the policy group.
discovery.policyGroup.replaceWithGroup.description: Error shown on the Policy Discovery form when a policy group is entered while the save mode is Replace.

discovery.policyGroup.tooLong.defaultMessage: Policy group must be at most {maxLength} characters.
discovery.policyGroup.tooLong.description: Validation error of a policy group name that is too long. {maxLength} is the maximum length (64).

discovery.policyGroupChange.append.description: Option: add the upload’s rules to the policy group, keeping every existing rule.

discovery.policyGroupChange.appendDescri.defaultMessage: Keep every existing rule. A rule whose name the group already holds is added under a new name.
discovery.policyGroupChange.appendDescri.description: Explanation of the Add to group option.

discovery.policyGroupChange.groupAmbiguo.defaultMessage: More than one policy class carries this group ({classNames}). Merge them, or remove the group from all but one, in Configuration → Policy Schema.
discovery.policyGroupChange.groupAmbiguo.description: Error when several policy classes carry the typed group. {classNames} lists their names.

discovery.policyGroupChange.loadError.defaultMessage: Could not read the profile's policy groups: {message}
discovery.policyGroupChange.loadError.description: Error when the selected configuration profile could not be read. {message} is the reason.

discovery.policyGroupChange.loading.description: Shown while the selected configuration profile is being read.

discovery.policyGroupChange.modeDescript.defaultMessage: Rules are matched only by the names you choose here, never guessed. Superseded rules are removed from the group; earlier revisions of the profile still hold them.
discovery.policyGroupChange.modeDescript.description: Help text of the policy group change choice.

discovery.policyGroupChange.modeLabel.defaultMessage: How this upload changes the group
discovery.policyGroupChange.modeLabel.description: Label of the choice of how a Policy Discovery upload changes an existing policy group.

discovery.policyGroupChange.newGroup.defaultMessage: The selected profile has no policy group with this name yet, so this upload creates it.
discovery.policyGroupChange.newGroup.description: Shown when the typed policy group does not exist in the selected profile.

discovery.policyGroupChange.noRulesChose.defaultMessage: Choose at least one rule to supersede, or choose Add to group.
discovery.policyGroupChange.noRulesChose.description: Validation error when Supersede is chosen with no rules selected.

discovery.policyGroupChange.replace.description: Option: the upload’s rules become the policy group’s whole ruleset (for an amended manual).

discovery.policyGroupChange.replaceDescr.defaultMessage: For an amended manual: this upload's rules replace all {count, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} in the group. The class keeps its name, description and regexes. Other policy classes are not touched.
discovery.policyGroupChange.replaceDescr.description: Explanation of the Replace this group’s rules option. {count} is the number of rules the group holds now.

discovery.policyGroupChange.rulesDescrip.defaultMessage: Choose from the rules the group holds now in the selected configuration profile.
discovery.policyGroupChange.rulesDescrip.description: Help text of the superseded rules multiselect.

discovery.policyGroupChange.rulesLabel.description: Label of the multiselect of existing group rules a rider supersedes.

discovery.policyGroupChange.rulesPlaceho.description: Placeholder of the superseded rules multiselect.

discovery.policyGroupChange.supersede.description: Option: remove the rules the user chooses and add the upload’s rules (for a rider or amendment page).

discovery.policyGroupChange.supersedeDes.defaultMessage: For a rider: the rules you choose are removed and this upload's rules are added. A new rule with a superseded rule's name takes its place; the rest are added alongside.
discovery.policyGroupChange.supersedeDes.description: Explanation of the Supersede chosen rules option.

documentActions.bar.details.description: Option of the document page's view switch: shows the document's details, sections and pages.

documentActions.bar.edit.description: Primary button of the document page's action bar: opens the document's edit page.

documentActions.bar.editInQueue.defaultMessage: Edit this document in its review queue
documentActions.bar.editInQueue.description: Screen-reader name of the Edit button while the document is in a review queue, where Edit opens its queue item.

documentActions.bar.moreActions.description: Menu of the document page's action bar with the changes, the downloads, and Reprocess, Abort and Delete.

documentActions.bar.refresh.description: Button of the document page's action bar that reads the document again.

documentActions.bar.reports.description: Menu of the document page's action bar that opens the document's reports.

documentActions.bar.source.description: Option of the document page's view switch: shows the source document in place of its details.

documentActions.bar.startReview.description: Button of the document page's action bar with which a reviewer takes the document's pending review.

documentActions.bar.troubleshoot.description: Button of the document page's action bar that opens Troubleshoot, where an agent looks into the document's processing.

documentActions.bar.viewSwitch.defaultMessage: Show the document's details or its source
documentActions.bar.viewSwitch.description: Screen-reader name of the Details | Source switch at the start of the document page's action bar.

documentActions.baseline.available.description: Value of the Evaluation field of Document Details once the document's results are in the evaluation baseline.

documentActions.baseline.copyFailed.defaultMessage: The copy of {name} to the evaluation baseline failed.
documentActions.baseline.copyFailed.description: Error notification when a running copy of the document to the evaluation baseline ended in an error. {name} is the document name.

documentActions.baseline.copyStarted.defaultMessage: Copying {name} to the evaluation baseline. Its evaluation status shows when the copy is done.
documentActions.baseline.copyStarted.description: Success notification after Use As Evaluation Baseline started the copy. {name} is the document name.

documentActions.baseline.copying.description: Value of the Evaluation field of Document Details while the document's results are copied to the evaluation baseline.

documentActions.baseline.failed.description: Value of the Evaluation field of Document Details when the copy of the document's results to the evaluation baseline failed.

documentActions.baseline.notApplicable.description: Value of the Evaluation field of Document Details when the document has no evaluation status.

documentActions.baseline.useFailed.defaultMessage: Could not use {name} as the evaluation baseline: {error}
documentActions.baseline.useFailed.description: Error notification when Use As Evaluation Baseline could not start the copy. {name} is the document name; {error} is the server's reason.

documentActions.download.all.description: Item of the document page's More Actions menu: downloads the document's files as a ZIP, after asking what to include.

documentActions.download.baselines.description: Item of the document page's More Actions menu: downloads the document's evaluation baseline as a ZIP.

documentActions.download.failed.description: Error notification when a download from the document page failed. {error} is the reason as the browser or the server gave it, or "Unknown error".

documentActions.download.menu.description: Name of the document page's downloads menu, whose items show as a group in the More Actions menu.

documentActions.download.predictions.description: Item of the document page's More Actions menu: downloads the document's extraction results as a ZIP.

documentActions.download.unknownError.description: Stands for the reason in "Download failed: …" when the failure gave none.

documentActions.editPageText.notice.defaultMessage: Save and Reprocess saves this page's text, then extracts again the sections that hold the page, replacing their values, including any corrected by hand. If the document is waiting for review, its review is marked as completed, and its rule validation results are cleared.
documentActions.editPageText.notice.description: Notice in the document page's page text editor: what Save and Reprocess, the label of its save button, replaces.

documentActions.editPageText.save.description: Button of the document page's page text editor: saves the page's text, then reprocesses the document.

documentActions.editPageText.saved.defaultMessage: Saved page {pageId}'s text of {name}. The sections that hold it are being extracted again.

documents.downloadOptions.scope.predicti.defaultMessage: Packages the extracted section predictions (the model's output JSON) into a single ZIP archive.
documents.downloadOptions.scope.predicti.description: What the Download Predictions export contains, in the download options dialog.

documents.downloadOptions.start.description: Button of the download options dialog that starts building the ZIP archive.

documents.downloadOptions.title.description: Title of the download options dialog for one document.

documents.downloadOptions.titleBulk.defaultMessage: Download data for {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}
documents.downloadOptions.titleBulk.description: Title of the download options dialog for several documents. {count} is the number of selected documents (2 or more).

documents.downloadProgress.cancel.description: Button of the download progress dialog that stops the export.

documents.downloadProgress.cancelling.description: Cancel button of the download progress dialog once cancelling is requested.

documents.downloadProgress.close.description: Button that closes the download progress dialog once the download is complete.

documents.downloadProgress.done.description: Title of the download progress dialog once the archive is ready.

documents.downloadProgress.errorsBody.defaultMessage: These entries were skipped and recorded in the archive's manifest.json:
documents.downloadProgress.errorsBody.description: Introduces the list of files left out of the archive; the file name in <code> stays as written.

documents.downloadProgress.errorsTitle.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} could not be included
documents.downloadProgress.errorsTitle.description: Heading of the list of files left out of the archive. {count} is the number of files.

documents.downloadProgress.files.defaultMessage: {completed, number} of {total, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} processed
documents.downloadProgress.files.description: Progress of a one-document export. {completed} and {total} count the files (and the final archive step).

documents.downloadProgress.filesAndDocum.defaultMessage: {completed, number} of {total, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} processed · {documentsCompleted, number} of {documentsTotal, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}
documents.downloadProgress.filesAndDocum.description: Progress of a several-document export. {completed} and {total} count files; {documentsCompleted} and {documentsTotal} count documents.

documents.downloadProgress.label.description: Label of the progress bar in the download progress dialog.

documents.downloadProgress.loaded.defaultMessage: {completed, number} of {total, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} loaded
documents.downloadProgress.loaded.description: Progress of loading the selected documents before a bulk export. {completed} and {total} count documents.

documents.downloadProgress.more.description: Last line of the list of files left out of the archive. {count} is the number of entries not listed.

documents.downloadProgress.preparing.description: Title of the download progress dialog while the archive is being built.

documents.downloadProgress.stage.done.description: Shown under the export progress bar once the archive is ready.

documents.downloadProgress.stage.generat.description: Shown under the export progress bar when the ZIP archive starts being built.
Shown under the export progress bar while the ZIP archive is built. {ratio} is how far it is (0 to 1).

documents.downloadProgress.stage.prepari.description: Shown under the export progress bar while the download links are being prepared.

documents.estimatedCost.column.context.description: Column header of the cost table in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page: the processing phase a line was metered in, such as Extraction.

documents.estimatedCost.column.cost.description: Column header of the cost table in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page: a line's cost, and the subtotal and total rows' amounts.

documents.estimatedCost.column.serviceAp.description: Column header of the cost table in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page: the service a line was metered for, with its API or model, such as textract/analyze_document. A phase's subtotal row shows its prompt-cache note in this column.

documents.estimatedCost.column.unit.description: Column header of the cost table in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page: what a line counts, such as inputTokens.

documents.estimatedCost.column.unitCost.description: Column header of the cost table in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page: the stack's price for one unit.

documents.estimatedCost.column.value.description: Column header of the cost table in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page: how many units a line metered.

documents.estimatedCost.costCell.description: A subtotal or total cell of the Estimated Cost column in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page. {label} is the row's label, such as "Extraction Subtotal" or "Total", and {cost} its amount in US dollars, formatted for the UI language.

documents.estimatedCost.loadingPricing.description: Shown in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page while the stack's pricing loads.

documents.estimatedCost.subtotal.description: Label of a phase's subtotal row in the Estimated Cost column of Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page, before the amount. {context} is the phase as metered, such as Extraction, shown as written.

documents.estimatedCost.title.description: Title of the dialog Reports › Estimated Cost opens on the document page. {cost} is the document's estimated cost per page, in US dollars formatted for the UI language.

documents.estimatedCost.total.description: Label of the document's total row in the Estimated Cost column of Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page, before the amount.

documents.estimatedCost.unpricedCost.description: Estimated Cost cell of a line in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page when the stack's pricing has no price for its unit. The line is left out of every total.

documents.estimatedCost.unpricedUnitCost.description: Unit Cost cell of a line in Reports › Estimated Cost on the document page when the stack's pricing has no price for its unit. The line is left out of every total.

documents.evaluationReport.allMetrics.de.defaultMessage: Every figure the run recorded, with the rating the report applies to it
documents.evaluationReport.allMetrics.de.description: Description under the All metrics heading in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.allMetrics.ex.description: Heading of the metrics table of the document's extraction, under All metrics in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.
Shown in the metrics table of the document's extraction, under All metrics in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, when the evaluation recorded none.

documents.evaluationReport.allMetrics.he.description: Heading of the metrics tables of the whole document in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.allMetrics.sp.description: Heading of the metrics table of the document's split and classification, under All metrics in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.backToSummary.description: Button above the evaluation report shown as markdown in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, after Markdown report was chosen: goes back to the scores and tables.

documents.evaluationReport.band.bad.description: Rating of a score in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, beside a headline score and in the Rating column of a metrics table. The worst of four: a score under 50%, or an error rate above 50%.

documents.evaluationReport.band.fair.description: Rating of a score in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, beside a headline score and in the Rating column of a metrics table. The second of four: a score from 70% to under 90%, or an error rate above 10% up to 30%.

documents.evaluationReport.band.good.description: Rating of a score in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, beside a headline score and in the Rating column of a metrics table. The best of four: a score of 90% or more, or an error rate of 10% or less.

documents.evaluationReport.band.poor.description: Rating of a score in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, beside a headline score and in the Rating column of a metrics table. The third of four: a score from 50% to under 70%, or an error rate above 30% up to 50%.

documents.evaluationReport.documentNotSc.defaultMessage: No section had an extractable schema, so accuracy figures would be meaningless and are omitted.
documents.evaluationReport.documentNotSc.description: Text of the notice in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when no section of the document could be scored, and the evaluation recorded no reason.

documents.evaluationReport.documentNotSc.defaultMessage: No section had an extractable schema ({reason}), so accuracy figures would be meaningless and are omitted.
documents.evaluationReport.documentNotSc.description: Text of the notice in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when no section of the document could be scored. {reason} is the reason the evaluation recorded, as it writes it.
Heading of a notice in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when no section of the document could be scored.

documents.evaluationReport.excluded.clas.description: Column header of the table of sections the evaluation skipped, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the section's class.

documents.evaluationReport.excluded.desc.defaultMessage: Skipped by evaluation and not counted in the figures above
documents.evaluationReport.excluded.desc.description: Description under the heading of the sections the evaluation skipped, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.excluded.expl.defaultMessage: A section is excluded when its class is marked {key}, or when the class defines no extractable attributes in the evaluation schema.
documents.evaluationReport.excluded.expl.description: Explanation above the table of sections the evaluation skipped, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {key} is the schema setting that marks a class, x-aws-idp-exclude-from-processing, shown as code.

documents.evaluationReport.excluded.head.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# section not evaluated} other {# sections not evaluated}}
documents.evaluationReport.excluded.head.description: Heading of the sections the evaluation skipped, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {count} is how many sections it skipped.

documents.evaluationReport.excluded.page.description: Column header of the table of sections the evaluation skipped, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the section's pages.

documents.evaluationReport.excluded.reas.description: Column header of the table of sections the evaluation skipped, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: why the evaluation skipped the section, as it writes it.

documents.evaluationReport.excluded.sect.description: Column header of the table of sections the evaluation skipped, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the section's id.

documents.evaluationReport.excludedReaso.description: Exclusion reason of a section the evaluation skipped, in the sections not evaluated of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, when the evaluation recorded no reason.

documents.evaluationReport.executionTime.description: Last line of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {executionTime} is how long the document's evaluation ran, such as 12.3 s or 2 min 5 s.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.aggreg.description: Score of a field whose score is computed over the comparisons nested under it, in a field table of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {score} is the score, with three decimals.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.compar.description: Shown in the Method column of a field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page for a comparison that has a reason but no recorded method; choosing it shows the reason.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.confid.description: Column header of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the confidence of the extracted value, with its threshold when there is one.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.empty.description: Shown in a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the section has no fields.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.expect.description: Column header of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the field's expected value.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.extrac.description: Column header of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the value extraction produced.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.fieldC.description: Column header of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the field's name.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.hideNe.description: Accessible label of the button that closes a field's open row in a field table of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, hiding the comparisons nested under the field. {name} is the field's name.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.match.description: Badge on a row of a field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the extracted value matched the expected one.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.method.description: Column header of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the comparison method used, named as the evaluation names it.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.mismat.description: Badge on a row of a field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the extracted value did not match the expected one.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.paired.description: Note under the name of a nested comparison in a field table of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, when the extracted value it was compared with is at another path, as when list items were matched out of order. {path} is that path, relative to the field.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.scoreC.description: Column header of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the comparison's score.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.showNe.description: Accessible label of the button that opens a field's row in a field table of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, showing the comparisons nested under the field. {name} is the field's name.

documents.evaluationReport.fields.weight.description: Column header of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the field's weight in the weighted score.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.addConfig.defaultMessage: Add a configuration for ''{className}'' in the evaluation config
documents.evaluationReport.fix.addConfig.description: First How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because the evaluation configuration has none for its class. {className} is the section's document class; the quotes around it stay.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.addConfig.defaultMessage: Add a configuration for 'this class' in the evaluation config
documents.evaluationReport.fix.addConfig.description: First How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because the evaluation configuration has none for its class, when the section has no class. The quoted words stand for the class.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.addNested.defaultMessage: Add at least one property to the nested object named above, or remove it from the schema
documents.evaluationReport.fix.addNested.description: First How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because a nested object in its class's schema has no properties. The error above the steps names the object.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.checkTrun.defaultMessage: Check whether the response was truncated (raise max_tokens) or wrapped in commentary
documents.evaluationReport.fix.checkTrun.description: Second How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because its extraction result could not be read as JSON. max_tokens is a configuration setting's name, written as is.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.compareBa.defaultMessage: Compare the baseline (expected) values against the class schema — the types disagree
documents.evaluationReport.fix.compareBa.description: First How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because its baseline values do not have the types its class's schema expects. Baseline values are the expected values the extraction is compared with.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.fixBaseli.defaultMessage: Fix the baseline data, or widen the schema field type, and re-run the evaluation
documents.evaluationReport.fix.fixBaseli.description: Second How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because its baseline values do not have the types its class's schema expects.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.matchClas.defaultMessage: Ensure the document class name matches exactly (case-insensitive)
documents.evaluationReport.fix.matchClas.description: Second How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because the evaluation configuration has none for its class.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.openExtra.defaultMessage: Open the section's extraction output — the model's response was not parseable JSON
documents.evaluationReport.fix.openExtra.description: First How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because its extraction result could not be read as JSON. JSON is a data format's name.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.provideBa.defaultMessage: Or provide baseline data when evaluating, so a configuration can be generated
documents.evaluationReport.fix.provideBa.description: Third How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because the evaluation configuration has none for its class. Baseline data is the expected values the extraction is compared with.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.rerunEval.description: Second How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because a nested object in its class's schema has no properties.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.rerunExtr.defaultMessage: Re-run extraction for this document, then re-evaluate
documents.evaluationReport.fix.rerunExtr.description: Third How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because its extraction result could not be read as JSON.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.rerunOnce.defaultMessage: Re-run the evaluation once the schema is valid
documents.evaluationReport.fix.rerunOnce.description: Second How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because of another error in the evaluation schema of its class.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.reviewSch.defaultMessage: Review the evaluation schema for ''{className}'' against the error above
documents.evaluationReport.fix.reviewSch.description: First How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because of another error in the evaluation schema of its class, which is shown above the steps. {className} is the section's document class; the quotes around it stay.

documents.evaluationReport.fix.reviewSch.defaultMessage: Review the evaluation schema for 'this class' against the error above
documents.evaluationReport.fix.reviewSch.description: First How to fix step for a section of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page that was not evaluated because of another error in the evaluation schema of its class, which is shown above the steps, when the section has no class. The quoted words stand for the class.

documents.evaluationReport.help.arrayMat.description: Heading under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: how lists are compared.

documents.evaluationReport.help.date.defaultMessage: {method} — compares resolved dates, not surface form (2024-01-05 equals January 5, 2024); ranges and day-first via {key}.
documents.evaluationReport.help.date.description: Explains a comparison method under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} is its name as the evaluation writes it, Date, in bold. The two dates in <code> are examples of one date written two ways, which a translation may write as its language writes dates. {key} is the schema setting, x-aws-idp-evaluation-method-config, shown as code.

documents.evaluationReport.help.exact.description: Explains a comparison method under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} is its name as the evaluation writes it, Exact, in bold.

documents.evaluationReport.help.fieldMet.description: Heading under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.help.fuzzy.defaultMessage: {method} / {other} — string similarity against a threshold. Names, addresses, minor variations.
documents.evaluationReport.help.fuzzy.description: Explains two comparison methods under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} and {other} are their names as the evaluation writes them, Fuzzy and Levenshtein, in bold.

documents.evaluationReport.help.graded.defaultMessage: Graded packet score — a softer companion to the exact-match figures: clustering (V-measure and Rand index) rewards pages grouped together correctly even when a section is not reproduced exactly, and ordering rewards pages kept in sequence within their section.
documents.evaluationReport.help.graded.description: Explains a split metric under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. The bold parts are the metric's name and the names of its two parts; V-measure and Rand index are names of clustering metrics.

documents.evaluationReport.help.hungaria.defaultMessage: {method} — optimal one-to-one pairing between the expected and extracted lists; each pair is then compared field by field, which is what the expandable rows above show. Configured with {key} on the array.
documents.evaluationReport.help.hungaria.description: Explains a list matching method under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} is its name as the evaluation writes it, Hungarian, in bold; {key} is the schema setting that selects it, x-aws-idp-evaluation-method: "HUNGARIAN", shown as code.

documents.evaluationReport.help.llm.defaultMessage: {method} — a Bedrock model judges the pair with reasoning, configured under {key}. Nested objects, semantic equivalence.
documents.evaluationReport.help.llm.description: Explains a comparison method under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} is its name as the evaluation writes it, LLM, in bold. Bedrock is the name of an AWS service. {key} is the configuration setting, evaluation.llm_method, shown as code.

documents.evaluationReport.help.llmArray.defaultMessage: {method} for arrays — judges whether two lists match as a whole.
documents.evaluationReport.help.llmArray.description: Explains a list matching method under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} is the name of the comparison method as the evaluation writes it, LLM; the bold part names the method used on lists.

documents.evaluationReport.help.numericE.defaultMessage: {method} — numeric comparison with a tolerance from {key}. Amounts, percentages.
documents.evaluationReport.help.numericE.description: Explains a comparison method under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} is its name as the evaluation writes it, NumericExact, in bold; {key} is the schema setting that holds the tolerance, x-aws-idp-evaluation-threshold, shown as code.

documents.evaluationReport.help.pageLeve.defaultMessage: Page-level accuracy — each page's predicted class against its expected class, ignoring how pages were grouped.
documents.evaluationReport.help.pageLeve.description: Explains a split metric under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. The bold part is the metric's name.

documents.evaluationReport.help.semantic.defaultMessage: {method} — embedding similarity against a threshold. Text where meaning matters more than wording.
documents.evaluationReport.help.semantic.description: Explains a comparison method under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {method} is its name as the evaluation writes it, Semantic, in bold.

documents.evaluationReport.help.splitMet.description: Heading under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, shown when the document was evaluated against expected sections: the metrics of the document's split into sections.

documents.evaluationReport.help.splitWit.defaultMessage: Split accuracy (with order) — the same, and the page order must match exactly. The strictest of the three.
documents.evaluationReport.help.splitWit.description: Explains a split metric under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, after the one without order. The bold part is the metric's name.

documents.evaluationReport.help.splitWit.defaultMessage: Split accuracy (without order) — an expected section counts as correct when a predicted section has the same set of pages and the same class.
documents.evaluationReport.help.splitWit.description: Explains a split metric under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. The bold part is the metric's name.

documents.evaluationReport.help.weightin.description: Heading under How scores are computed in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: how field weights count.

documents.evaluationReport.help.weightin.defaultMessage: {key} sets a field's importance (default 1.0). The weighted overall score is Σ(weight × score) / Σ(weight) per section, and the document score is the average across sections. The weight column above shows each field's value.
documents.evaluationReport.help.weightin.description: Text under Field weighting in How scores are computed of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {key} is the schema setting, x-aws-idp-evaluation-weight, shown as code. The formula gives a section's weighted score.

documents.evaluationReport.howScores.description: Heading of the explanation of the comparison methods and the scores, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.listSize.description: The Expected or Extracted value of a field in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the value is a list; choosing it shows the list. {count} is how many items the list has.

documents.evaluationReport.loading.description: Shown in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page while the document's evaluation results load.

documents.evaluationReport.markdownEmpty.defaultMessage: Evaluation report not available for this document
documents.evaluationReport.markdownEmpty.description: Shown in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the document has no evaluation report.

documents.evaluationReport.markdownRepor.description: Button in the header of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: shows the evaluation report as generated, a Markdown file, with its own download and print buttons.

documents.evaluationReport.methods.body.defaultMessage: A surprising score is often a comparison-method question rather than an extraction one. This document used: {methods}.
documents.evaluationReport.methods.body.description: Text under Comparison methods used in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {methods} lists the comparison methods the document's evaluation used, named as the evaluation names them and separated by commas.

documents.evaluationReport.methods.heade.description: Heading of the list of comparison methods the document's evaluation used, in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.metrics.exclu.description: Rating, in a metrics table of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, of a metric the evaluation recorded without a value.

documents.evaluationReport.metrics.metri.description: Column header of a metrics table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the metric's name, as the evaluation records it.

documents.evaluationReport.metrics.notSc.description: In a metrics table of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the value of a metric the evaluation recorded without one, and the rating of every metric of a section that was not evaluated.

documents.evaluationReport.metrics.ratin.description: Column header of a metrics table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the metric's rating.

documents.evaluationReport.metrics.value.description: Column header of a metrics table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the metric's value.

documents.evaluationReport.misclassified.defaultMessage: Some pages are not the class ground truth expects
documents.evaluationReport.misclassified.description: Heading of a warning in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when pages were classified otherwise than the ground truth classifies them.

documents.evaluationReport.misclassified.defaultMessage: Extraction runs against the assigned class's schema, so the fields for those pages may be wrong even where they look plausible. Correct the class and re-extract before reading the numbers here.
documents.evaluationReport.misclassified.description: Note at the end of the warning in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page about pages classified otherwise than the ground truth classifies them.

documents.evaluationReport.misclassified.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Page} other {Pages}} {pages} classified as {predicted}, but ground truth says {expected}.
documents.evaluationReport.misclassified.description: Line of the warning in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page about pages classified otherwise than the ground truth classifies them. {count} is how many pages the line lists; {pages} lists their numbers, as ranges such as 2-3; {predicted} is the class they were given; {expected} is the class the ground truth gives them. <b> makes a part bold.

documents.evaluationReport.mismatchesOnl.description: Toggle in the header of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: when it is on, each section's field table lists only the fields that did not match.

documents.evaluationReport.objectSize.description: The Expected or Extracted value of a field in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the value is an object; choosing it shows the object. {count} is how many fields the object has.

documents.evaluationReport.section.allMa.defaultMessage: Every field in this section matched.
documents.evaluationReport.section.allMa.description: Shown in place of a section's field table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when Mismatches only is on and every field of the section matched.

documents.evaluationReport.section.could.defaultMessage: This section could not be evaluated for document class {className}.
documents.evaluationReport.section.could.description: Text of the error in a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the section could not be evaluated and the evaluation recorded no reason. {className} is the section's document class.

documents.evaluationReport.section.could.defaultMessage: This section could not be evaluated for document class unknown.
documents.evaluationReport.section.could.description: Text of the error in a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the section could not be evaluated and the evaluation recorded neither a reason nor a class.

documents.evaluationReport.section.heade.description: Heading of a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {sectionId} is the section's id; {className} is its document class.
Heading of a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the evaluation recorded no class for it. {sectionId} is the section's id.

documents.evaluationReport.section.howTo.description: Heading of the steps that fix a section's evaluation, in the error in a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the section could not be evaluated.

documents.evaluationReport.section.metri.description: Heading of a section's metrics table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page.

documents.evaluationReport.section.misma.description: Shown in parentheses beside a section's heading in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page, after the section's score and a middle dot. {count} is how many of its fields did not match.

documents.evaluationReport.section.notEv.description: Heading of an error in a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the section could not be evaluated.

documents.evaluationReport.section.notSc.description: Shown in parentheses beside a section's heading in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the section was not evaluated.

documents.evaluationReport.section.place.defaultMessage: It contributes zero to every document-level figure above. Its metrics below are placeholders for a section that was never scored, not measurements of a bad extraction.
documents.evaluationReport.section.place.description: Note in the error in a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when the section could not be evaluated.

documents.evaluationReport.section.skipp.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# field was excluded from scoring because it could not be validated against the schema. The remaining fields were evaluated normally.} other {# fields were excluded from scoring because they could not be validated against the schema. The remaining fields were evaluated normally.}}
documents.evaluationReport.section.skipp.description: Warning in a section's results in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page. {count} is how many of its fields the evaluation left out because their values did not fit the class's schema.

documents.evaluationReport.split.cluster.description: Part of the graded packet score line under the Section split analysis table in Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page: the clustering part of that score. {score} is a percentage.

documents.evaluationReport.split.empty.description: Shown in the Section split analysis table of Reports › Evaluation Report on the document page when it has no sections.
