documents.versions.comparing.description: Shown in the compare dialog while the two versions are compared.

documents.versions.currentBadge.description: Badge on the newest version, the one the document page shows.

documents.versions.delete.description: Confirm button of the delete dialog: deletes the version.

documents.versions.deleteConfirm.description: Question in the delete dialog. {when} is the version's completion date and time, or its run id when it has none.

documents.versions.deleteFailed.description: Error shown when a version cannot be deleted.

documents.versions.deleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that deletes a version.

documents.versions.deleteVersion.description: Menu item, for administrators, that deletes the version.

documents.versions.deleteWarning.defaultMessage: This permanently deletes the pinned output object versions for this run. This cannot be undone.

documents.versions.description.defaultMessage: Each successful processing run of this document is retained as a version. Compare any two, or delete old versions to reclaim storage.
documents.versions.description.description: Description under the Version History heading.

documents.versions.diffColumn.change.description: Column header of the compare table: the kind of change.

documents.versions.diffColumn.earlier.description: Column header of the compare table: the earlier version's value.

documents.versions.diffColumn.field.description: Column header of the compare table: the field that changed.

documents.versions.diffColumn.later.description: Column header of the compare table: the later version's value.

documents.versions.diffStatus.changed.description: Status of a compared section whose extraction results differ between the two versions.

documents.versions.diffStatus.identical.description: Status of a compared section whose extraction results are the same in both versions.

documents.versions.diffStatus.onlyInA.description: Status of a compared section that only the earlier version has.

documents.versions.diffStatus.onlyInB.description: Status of a compared section that only the later version has.

documents.versions.earlierProfile.description: Label of the earlier version in the compare dialog. {config} is its configuration profile, or the N/A text.

documents.versions.empty.body.defaultMessage: A version is recorded each time this document completes processing.
documents.versions.empty.body.description: Text of the version table when the document has no version.

documents.versions.empty.title.description: Heading of the version table when the document has no version.

documents.versions.identical.defaultMessage: The extraction results are identical across these two versions.
documents.versions.identical.description: Shown in the compare dialog when the two versions have the same extraction results.

documents.versions.laterProfile.description: Label of the later version in the compare dialog. {config} is its configuration profile, or the N/A text.

documents.versions.loadFailed.description: Error shown when the version list cannot be loaded.

documents.versions.loading.description: Shown in the version table while the version list loads.

documents.versions.noFieldChanges.description: Shown in the compare dialog for a section with no changed field.

documents.versions.notApplicable.description: Shown when a version has no configuration profile recorded.

documents.versions.refresh.description: Button that reloads the version list.

documents.versions.returnToCurrent.description: Button that returns the document page to the current version.

documents.versions.shownReason.description: Why the View menu item is disabled: the page shows this version.

documents.versions.title.description: Heading of the Version History panel on the document page.

documents.versions.view.description: Menu item that shows the version on the document page.

documents.versions.viewAction.description: Action phrase completing an API error sentence ("Failed to …: <error>" / "You do not have permission to …") when a version cannot be loaded for viewing.

documents.versions.viewing.description: Disabled menu item on the version the document page shows.

documents.versions.viewingPrevious.defaultMessage: Viewing a previous version (read-only). Extraction results and page text shown below reflect this version's output.
documents.versions.viewingPrevious.description: Notice shown while the document page shows a previous version.

editScreen.bar.cancel.description: Button of the edit page's action bar that discards the unsaved changes and leaves the page.

editScreen.bar.cancelAriaLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the edit page's Cancel button, which says what Cancel does to unsaved changes.

editScreen.bar.cancelHint.defaultMessage: Discard your unsaved changes and leave
editScreen.bar.cancelHint.description: Hover text of Cancel while it is available.

editScreen.bar.claim.description: Button of the edit page's action bar that assigns the item to the user, for an Annotator viewing an unassigned item.

editScreen.bar.claimHint.defaultMessage: Assign this item to you, then work it here or from Home › Tasks
editScreen.bar.claimHint.description: Hover text of Claim. "Home › Tasks", the page of the review items assigned to the user, is named by its breadcrumb trail.

editScreen.bar.moreActions.description: Menu of the edit page's action bar that holds Use As Evaluation Baseline.

editScreen.bar.processingReport.description: Item of the edit page's Reports menu, and the title of the dialog it opens, which shows how the open section was extracted.

editScreen.bar.refresh.description: Button of the edit page's action bar that reads the document again.

editScreen.bar.reports.description: Menu of the edit page's action bar that holds History, Summary and Processing Report.

editScreen.bar.save.description: Button of the edit page's action bar that saves the changes without finishing.

editScreen.bar.skip.description: Button of the edit page's action bar that gives the item back to its queue, and the confirm button of the dialog that asks why.

editScreen.bar.skipHint.defaultMessage: Give this item back to its queue, unassigned and not finished.
editScreen.bar.skipHint.description: Hover text of Skip while it is available.

editScreen.bar.summary.description: Item of the edit page's Reports menu that opens the document's summary report.

editScreen.bar.useAsBaseline.description: Item of the edit page's More Actions menu that copies the finished document's results into its evaluation baseline.

editScreen.bar.viewEdit.description: Option of the edit page's Edit | View switch that shows the Document Editor.

editScreen.bar.viewSource.description: Option of the edit page's Edit | View switch that shows the source document.

editScreen.bar.viewSwitch.defaultMessage: Edit the document or view its source
editScreen.bar.viewSwitch.description: Screen-reader name of the Edit | View switch, first in the edit page's action bar.

editScreen.directEdit.baselineCopying.defaultMessage: Copying {name} to the evaluation baseline. Its evaluation status shows when the copy is done.
editScreen.directEdit.baselineCopying.description: Notice after Use As Evaluation Baseline on a document's edit page started copying the document to the evaluation baseline. {name} is the document's file name.

editScreen.directEdit.editRoleReason.defaultMessage: Editing needs the Admin or Author role, or a Reviewer who holds this document's review.
editScreen.directEdit.editRoleReason.description: Why a document's edit page is read-only, as the reason its actions are unavailable and in its read-only notice: the user is not an Admin or an Author, nor a Reviewer who holds the document's review.

editScreen.directEdit.failedBaseline.defaultMessage: Could not use {name} as the evaluation baseline: {error}
editScreen.directEdit.failedBaseline.description: Error on a document's edit page when Use As Evaluation Baseline failed. {name} is the document's file name; {error} is why: the server's error text, shown as is, or, for an error the edit page raises itself, that error's own message in the user's language.

editScreen.directEdit.failedProcess.description: Error on a document's edit page when Process Changes failed. {error} is why: the server's error text, shown as is, or, for an error the edit page raises itself, that error's own message in the user's language.

editScreen.directEdit.failedReload.description: Error on a document's edit page when Refresh could not read the document again. {name} is the document's file name; {error} is why: the server's error text, shown as is, or, for an error the edit page raises itself, that error's own message in the user's language.

editScreen.directEdit.inReviewNotice.defaultMessage: This document is in a review queue. Edits are made in the queue.
editScreen.directEdit.inReviewNotice.description: Read-only notice at the top of a document's edit page while the document is in a review queue.

editScreen.directEdit.inReviewSaveRefuse.defaultMessage: This document is now in a review queue, so it can't be edited here. Reload the page to work on it in its queue.
editScreen.directEdit.inReviewSaveRefuse.description: Why the section editor of a document's edit page could not save, shown after "Failed to save:": the server refused the save because the document went into a review queue after the page opened.

editScreen.directEdit.mirrorLagNotice.defaultMessage: View only. This document is marked as in a review queue, but its review item is missing or has finished. Reload in a moment.
editScreen.directEdit.mirrorLagNotice.description: Read-only notice at the top of a document's edit page in the case the sentence describes.

editScreen.directEdit.mirrorLagReason.defaultMessage: This document's review is being updated. Reload in a moment.
editScreen.directEdit.mirrorLagReason.description: Why the actions of a document's edit page are unavailable while the document is marked as in a review queue but its review item is missing or has finished.

editScreen.directEdit.noResultToEdit.defaultMessage: This section has no result to edit
editScreen.directEdit.noResultToEdit.description: Why the section editor of a document's edit page could not open a section, shown after "Failed to load ground truth:": the section has no extraction result.

editScreen.directEdit.noResultToSave.defaultMessage: This section has no result to save
editScreen.directEdit.noResultToSave.description: Why the section editor of a document's edit page could not save a section, shown after "Failed to save:": the section has no extraction result to write the changes to.

editScreen.directEdit.noSectionsToEdit.defaultMessage: This document has no sections to edit.
editScreen.directEdit.noSectionsToEdit.description: Shown in the section editor's place on a document's edit page when the document has no sections.

editScreen.directEdit.primaryHint.defaultMessage: Save your changes and process them: evaluation and summarization re-run; OCR, classification and extraction are not repeated.
editScreen.directEdit.primaryHint.description: Hint of Process Changes in the action bar of a document's edit page: what it does.

editScreen.directEdit.processOwnerReason.defaultMessage: {processChanges} needs an Admin, or the reviewer who holds this document's open review. Start the review first.
editScreen.directEdit.processOwnerReason.description: Why Process Changes is unavailable on a document's edit page for a Reviewer who does not hold the document's open review. {processChanges} is the action's name, Process Changes.

editScreen.directEdit.processRoleReason.defaultMessage: {processChanges} needs the Admin or Reviewer role.
editScreen.directEdit.processRoleReason.description: Why Process Changes is unavailable on a document's edit page: the user has neither the Admin nor the Reviewer role. {processChanges} is the action's name, Process Changes.

editScreen.directEdit.processing.defaultMessage: Processing the changes to {name}: evaluation and summarization are re-running.
editScreen.directEdit.processing.description: Notice shown as a document's edit page closes after Process Changes was confirmed. {name} is the document's file name.

editScreen.directEdit.processingNotice.defaultMessage: View only. This document is still processing; its results can be edited once processing finishes.
editScreen.directEdit.processingNotice.description: Read-only notice at the top of a document's edit page while the document is still processing.

editScreen.directEdit.regroupConsequence.defaultMessage: Moving pages rewrites this document's section grouping. The extracted field values are kept and the document is not reprocessed, so they may no longer match their pages. To have the pipeline redo them, open the document page's More Actions › Edit Page Grouping and choose Save and Re-extract: this screen's {processChanges} re-runs evaluation and summarization only.
editScreen.directEdit.regroupConsequence.description: What saving a new page grouping does, in Edit Page Grouping opened from a document's edit page. … marks bold text. More Actions › Edit Page Grouping is a menu item and Save and Re-extract a button, both on the document's own page; {processChanges} is the edit page's action, Process Changes.

editScreen.directEdit.regroupRoleReason.defaultMessage: Edit Page Grouping needs the Admin or Reviewer role.
editScreen.directEdit.regroupRoleReason.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable on a document's edit page: the user has neither the Admin nor the Reviewer role.

editScreen.directEdit.saved.description: Notice after Save on a document's edit page saved the open section's changes. {name} is the document's file name.

editScreen.directEdit.viewOnly.description: Read-only notice at the top of a document's edit page when the user's roles may not edit it. {reason} is a whole sentence saying which roles may.

editScreen.discard.body.defaultMessage: The changes you made since the last save are lost. Anything already saved is kept.
editScreen.discard.body.description: Text of the dialog the edit page shows before an action, such as Cancel or Refresh, loses unsaved changes.

editScreen.discard.cancel.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks before Cancel loses unsaved changes: it discards them and leaves the edit page.

editScreen.discard.cancel.header.description: Title of the dialog the edit page shows when Cancel would lose unsaved changes.

editScreen.discard.keepEditing.description: Button of the dialog that asks before unsaved changes are lost: it closes the dialog and keeps the changes.

editScreen.documentStatus.bdaRegroup.defaultMessage: Page grouping cannot be changed for a document processed with Bedrock Data Automation (BDA). Field values can still be edited.
editScreen.documentStatus.bdaRegroup.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable for a document processed with Bedrock Data Automation (BDA), the name of an AWS service.

editScreen.documentStatus.inReviewShort.defaultMessage: This document is in a review queue
editScreen.documentStatus.inReviewShort.description: Why a menu item about a document, such as Summary in the Reports menu, is unavailable while the document is in a review queue.

editScreen.documentStatus.noSections.description: Why Edit Page Grouping, or Re-extract Sections on the document page, is unavailable: the document has no sections.

editScreen.documentStatus.noSummary.description: Why Summary in the Reports menu is unavailable: the document has no summary report.

editScreen.documentStatus.processing.description: Why an action about a document, or its direct edit, is unavailable while the document is still processing.

editScreen.fieldEdits.appliesTo.baseline.description: Applies to cell of History › Field Edits on the edit page: the edit changed the section's evaluation baseline.

editScreen.fieldEdits.appliesTo.predicti.description: Applies to cell of History › Field Edits on the edit page: the edit changed the section's extracted values.

editScreen.fieldEdits.column.appliesTo.description: Column header of History › Field Edits on the edit page, shown when an edit changed the evaluation baseline: which values the edit changed.

editScreen.fieldEdits.column.by.description: Column header of History › Field Edits on the edit page: who saved the edit.

editScreen.fieldEdits.column.field.description: Column header of History › Field Edits on the edit page: the path of the field that was changed.

editScreen.fieldEdits.column.from.description: Column header of History › Field Edits on the edit page: the field's value before the edit.

editScreen.fieldEdits.column.to.description: Column header of History › Field Edits on the edit page: the field's value after the edit.

editScreen.fieldEdits.column.when.description: Column header of History › Field Edits on the edit page: when the edit was saved.

editScreen.fieldEdits.empty.noEdits.defaultMessage: No field has been edited in this section yet.
editScreen.fieldEdits.empty.noEdits.description: Shown in History › Field Edits on the edit page when no field of the open section has been edited.

editScreen.fieldEdits.empty.noSection.defaultMessage: Open a section to see its field edits.
editScreen.fieldEdits.empty.noSection.description: Shown in History › Field Edits on the edit page while no section is open.

editScreen.fieldEdits.emptyValue.description: From or To cell of History › Field Edits on the edit page when the field had no value.

editScreen.fieldEdits.unknownEditor.description: By cell of History › Field Edits on the edit page when the saved edit names nobody.

editScreen.history.tab.fieldEdits.description: Tab of the edit page's History dialog that lists every saved change to the open section's fields.

editScreen.history.tab.reviewActivity.description: Tab of the edit page's History dialog that lists who claimed, was assigned, skipped or completed the item, and why.

editScreen.page.claim.description: Button in the edit page's notice that the fields are read-only, which assigns the item to the user so it can be edited.

editScreen.page.refreshDiscard.confirm.description: Confirm button of the dialog that asks before Refresh loses unsaved changes: it discards them and reads the document again.

editScreen.page.refreshDiscard.header.description: Title of the dialog the edit page shows when Refresh would lose unsaved changes.

editScreen.pageGrouping.close.description: Button that closes the dialog reporting a re-extract that failed after Save and Re-extract saved the grouping.

editScreen.pageGrouping.partialFailed.defaultMessage: The page grouping was saved, but the sections were not re-extracted: {message}
editScreen.pageGrouping.partialFailed.description: Error in the dialog shown when Save and Re-extract saved the grouping but the re-extract failed, above the list of those sections. {message} is why, as the request reported it, shown as is.

editScreen.pageGrouping.reextractAgain.description: Button of the dialog reporting a re-extract that failed after Save and Re-extract saved the grouping: tries the re-extract again.

editScreen.pageGrouping.save.description: Button of the Edit Page Grouping dialog that saves the grouping.

editScreen.pageGrouping.saveAndReextract.description: Button of the Edit Page Grouping dialog on the document page: saves the grouping, then extracts again the sections whose class or pages changed, after a confirmation.

editScreen.pageGrouping.sectionLine.description: A section in the list of the dialog reporting a re-extract that failed after Save and Re-extract saved the grouping. {id} is the section's number; {class} is its document class, shown as is (empty for a section with no class); {count} is how many pages it has; {pages} lists their numbers, separated by commas.

editScreen.pageGrouping.thumbnailsUnavai.description: Heading of the alert in the Edit Page Grouping dialog shown when the page thumbnails could not be loaded.

editScreen.pageGrouping.title.description: Title of the Edit Page Grouping dialog, on the edit page and the document page, where the document's pages are regrouped into sections; also the title of the dialog that reports a re-extract that failed after the grouping was saved.

editScreen.productionItem.action.baselin.defaultMessage: use this document as the evaluation baseline
editScreen.productionItem.action.baselin.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Use As Evaluation Baseline failed on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.action.cancel.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Cancel failed on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.action.claim.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Claim failed on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.action.process.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Process Changes failed on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.action.refresh.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Refresh failed on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.action.regroup.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Edit Page Grouping could not open on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.action.save.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when a draft of a review queue item's section could not be saved.

editScreen.productionItem.action.saveGro.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Edit Page Grouping could not save the page grouping of a review queue item's document.

editScreen.productionItem.action.skip.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Skip failed on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.action.takeOve.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when Take over failed on a review queue item's edit page.

editScreen.productionItem.assignedElsewh.defaultMessage: This item was just assigned to someone else
editScreen.productionItem.assignedElsewh.description: Why the section editor of a review queue item's edit page could not save an Admin's edit, shown after "Failed to save:": another user was assigned the item first.

editScreen.productionItem.assignedJustNo.defaultMessage: Assigned to {assignee} just now. Take over to edit it and process its changes.
editScreen.productionItem.assignedJustNo.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page for an Admin whose first edit found the item just assigned to another user. {assignee} is that user's e-mail address; Take over is the button beside the notice.

editScreen.productionItem.assignedJustNo.defaultMessage: Assigned to another reviewer just now. Take over to edit it and process its changes.
editScreen.productionItem.assignedJustNo.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page for an Admin whose first edit found the item just assigned to another user, when that user is not known. Take over is the button beside the notice.

editScreen.productionItem.assignedTakeOv.defaultMessage: Assigned to {assignee}. Take over to edit it and process its changes.
editScreen.productionItem.assignedTakeOv.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page for an Admin when the item is assigned to another user. {assignee} is that user's e-mail address; Take over is the button beside the notice.

editScreen.productionItem.baselineCopyin.description: Notice after Use As Evaluation Baseline on a review queue item's edit page started copying the document to the evaluation baseline. {name} is the file name of the item's document.

editScreen.productionItem.claimToRegroup.defaultMessage: Claim this item first to change its page grouping
editScreen.productionItem.claimToRegroup.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable to an Annotator on an unassigned review queue item's edit page: only the item's holder may change its page grouping.

editScreen.productionItem.finalizeFailed.defaultMessage: Applying this review's corrections failed, so it can no longer be edited here. An Admin can see it in Review Management.
editScreen.productionItem.finalizeFailed.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page when applying the review's corrections failed. Review Management is a page of the app.

editScreen.productionItem.finished.compl.defaultMessage: This review is finished: the item is complete and can no longer be edited.
editScreen.productionItem.finished.compl.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page once the item's review is complete.

editScreen.productionItem.finished.final.defaultMessage: This review is finished: it was submitted and its corrections are being applied.
editScreen.productionItem.finished.final.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page while the submitted review's corrections are applied.

editScreen.productionItem.finished.other.defaultMessage: This review is finished: the item is {state} and can no longer be edited.
editScreen.productionItem.finished.other.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page, for a finished state the page does not know. {state} is that state as stored, in lower case.

editScreen.productionItem.finished.rejec.defaultMessage: This review is finished: the item is rejected and can no longer be edited.
editScreen.productionItem.finished.rejec.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page once the item was rejected.

editScreen.productionItem.finished.withd.defaultMessage: This review is finished: the item is withdrawn and can no longer be edited.
editScreen.productionItem.finished.withd.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page once the item was withdrawn from review.

editScreen.productionItem.holdingNotice.defaultMessage: This item is being prepared for review. It can be edited once it reaches its queue.
editScreen.productionItem.holdingNotice.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page while the item is being prepared for review.

editScreen.productionItem.latestEditsNot.defaultMessage: Your latest edits could not be saved
editScreen.productionItem.latestEditsNot.description: Why Process Changes failed on a review queue item's edit page, shown as the error inside the shared error sentence: the open section's latest edits could not be saved first.

editScreen.productionItem.loading.description: Shown beside a spinner while the edit page reads a review queue item.

editScreen.productionItem.locked.complet.description: Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: the item's review is complete.

editScreen.productionItem.locked.finaliz.description: Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: applying the review's corrections failed. The English uses the state's name, Finalize failed.
Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: the review was submitted and its corrections are being applied.

editScreen.productionItem.locked.holding.description: Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: the item is being prepared for review.

editScreen.productionItem.locked.other.description: Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page, for a state the page does not know. {state} is that state as stored, in lower case.

editScreen.productionItem.locked.rejecte.description: Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: the item was rejected.

editScreen.productionItem.locked.withdra.description: Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: the item was withdrawn from review.

editScreen.productionItem.noResultToRevi.defaultMessage: This section has no result to review
editScreen.productionItem.noResultToRevi.description: Why the section editor of a review queue item's edit page could not open a section, shown after "Failed to load ground truth:": the section has neither a draft nor an extraction result.

editScreen.productionItem.noSectionsToRe.defaultMessage: This item has no sections to review.
editScreen.productionItem.noSectionsToRe.description: Shown in the section editor's place on a review queue item's edit page when the item has no sections under review.

editScreen.productionItem.notAssignedToY.defaultMessage: This item is not assigned to you
editScreen.productionItem.notAssignedToY.description: Why Process Changes and Edit Page Grouping are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: the item is not assigned to the user.

editScreen.productionItem.notAssignedYet.defaultMessage: Not assigned yet. Editing it, or choosing {processChanges}, assigns it to you.
editScreen.productionItem.notAssignedYet.description: Notice at the top of an unassigned review queue item's edit page for an Admin. {processChanges} is the name of the page's action, Process Changes.

editScreen.productionItem.primaryHint.defaultMessage: Apply your corrections and finish the review: evaluation and summarization re-run; OCR, classification and extraction are not repeated.
editScreen.productionItem.primaryHint.description: Hint of Process Changes in the action bar of a review queue item's edit page: what it does.

editScreen.productionItem.processing.defaultMessage: Processing the changes to {name}: your corrections are being applied.
editScreen.productionItem.processing.description: Notice shown as a review queue item's edit page closes after Process Changes finished the review. {name} is the file name of the item's document.

editScreen.productionItem.regroupConsequ.defaultMessage: Moving pages rewrites this document's section grouping. The extracted values and your draft edits are kept with their sections, and the document finishes with this grouping when you choose {processChanges}. A section you remove takes its draft edits with it.
editScreen.productionItem.regroupConsequ.description: What saving a new page grouping does, in Edit Page Grouping opened from a review queue item's edit page. … marks bold text; {processChanges} is the edit page's action, Process Changes.

editScreen.productionItem.reviewNotCompl.defaultMessage: Available once the review is complete
editScreen.productionItem.reviewNotCompl.description: Why Summary and Use As Evaluation Baseline are unavailable on a review queue item's edit page: they are about the reviewed document.

editScreen.productionItem.savingLatest.description: Why an action of a review queue item's edit page, such as Save, Skip or Process Changes, is unavailable while the latest edits are being saved.

editScreen.productionItem.skipBody.defaultMessage: It goes back to its queue, unassigned and not finished. Your saved edits are kept for whoever picks it up next.
editScreen.productionItem.skipBody.description: Text of the dialog that Skip opens on a review queue item's edit page: what skipping the item does.

editScreen.productionItem.skipHeader.description: Title of the dialog that Skip opens on a review queue item's edit page, which asks why the item is skipped.

editScreen.productionItem.staleDraft.defaultMessage: Someone saved a newer draft of this section. It has been reloaded; reapply your last change.
editScreen.productionItem.staleDraft.description: Error on a review queue item's edit page when a save found a newer draft of the open section, which the page then reloaded.

editScreen.productionItem.takeOver.description: Button beside the read-only notice of a review queue item's edit page, for an Admin: it assigns the item, which another user holds, to the Admin.

editScreen.productionItem.takenOver.defaultMessage: {name} is assigned to you. {assignee} was told.
editScreen.productionItem.takenOver.description: Notice after Take over on a review queue item's edit page assigned the item to the Admin. {name} is the file name of the item's document; {assignee} is the former assignee's e-mail address.

editScreen.productionItem.takenOverNoAss.defaultMessage: {name} is assigned to you. The former assignee was told.
editScreen.productionItem.takenOverNoAss.description: Notice after Take over on a review queue item's edit page assigned the item to the Admin, when the former assignee is not known. {name} is the file name of the item's document.

editScreen.productionItem.viewOnly.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page when the user may not edit the item.

editScreen.productionItem.viewOnlyAssign.defaultMessage: View only. This item is assigned to {assignee}.
editScreen.productionItem.viewOnlyAssign.description: Read-only notice at the top of a review queue item's edit page when the item is assigned to another user. {assignee} is that user's e-mail address.

editScreen.productionItem.viewOnlyClaim.defaultMessage: View only. Claim this item to work on it; it is then assigned to you and shows in Home › Tasks.
editScreen.productionItem.viewOnlyClaim.description: Read-only notice at the top of an unassigned review queue item's edit page, beside its Claim button. Home › Tasks is the page that lists the user's work, named by its breadcrumb trail.

editScreen.reviewActivity.job.description: Part of a Review Activity note: the bulk job that made the review event. {jobId} is the job id.

editScreen.reviewActivity.notResubmitted.description: Part of a Review Activity note: Skip All Reviews ran without re-running Summarization, Evaluation and the post-processing hook.

editScreen.reviewActivity.section.description: Part of a Review Activity note in the edit page History: the section the review event was for. {sectionId} is the section id, e.g. "2".

editScreen.sectionEditor.baselineHint.defaultMessage: This document has an evaluation baseline. Turn on Show Evaluation to compare every field against it, not just the class.
editScreen.sectionEditor.baselineHint.description: Hint in the Visual Editor tab of the edit page's section editor while Show Evaluation is off and the document has an evaluation baseline. Show Evaluation names the toggle in the editor's header.

editScreen.sectionEditor.comparison.body.defaultMessage: Showing predicted values with evaluation baseline. Fields with mismatches are highlighted with evaluation scores and reasons.
editScreen.sectionEditor.comparison.body.description: Text of the note in the Visual Editor tab of the edit page's section editor while Show Evaluation is on.

editScreen.sectionEditor.comparison.head.description: Heading of the note in the Visual Editor tab of the edit page's section editor while Show Evaluation is on.

editScreen.sectionEditor.editPageGroupin.description: Button in the header of the edit page's section editor that opens the Edit Page Grouping dialog, which groups the document's pages into sections.

editScreen.sectionEditor.fieldLink.copie.description: Shown after Copy link to field, in the edit page's section editor, copied the link.

editScreen.sectionEditor.fieldLink.copy.description: Button in the Visual Editor tab of the edit page's section editor that copies a link to the selected field.

editScreen.sectionEditor.fieldLink.copyF.defaultMessage: Could not copy the field link
editScreen.sectionEditor.fieldLink.copyF.description: Shown after Copy link to field, in the edit page's section editor, could not copy the link.

editScreen.sectionEditor.fieldLink.descr.defaultMessage: Copies a link that opens this document with {path} selected. Share it when you need a second opinion on a value.
editScreen.sectionEditor.fieldLink.descr.description: Text under Ask someone about this field in the Visual Editor tab of the edit page's section editor. {path} is the selected field's path in the document's results (such as LineItems[0].Rate), shown as is.

editScreen.sectionEditor.fieldLink.label.description: Label above the button in the Visual Editor tab of the edit page's section editor that copies a link to the selected field.

editScreen.sectionEditor.filter.alerts.description: Choice of the menu in the header of the edit page's section editor that chooses which fields the Visual Editor tab shows: the fields whose confidence is below their threshold.

editScreen.sectionEditor.filter.all.description: Choice of the menu in the header of the edit page's section editor that chooses which fields the Visual Editor tab shows: every field.

editScreen.sectionEditor.filter.evalMism.description: Choice of the menu in the header of the edit page's section editor that chooses which fields the Visual Editor tab shows: the fields that differ from the evaluation baseline.

editScreen.sectionEditor.filterAriaLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the menu in the header of the edit page's section editor that chooses which fields the Visual Editor tab shows. {filter} is the current choice, as the menu shows it.

editScreen.sectionEditor.filterNeedsEval.description: Why the Evaluation mismatches only choice of the edit page's section editor is unavailable. Show Evaluation is the toggle beside the menu.

editScreen.sectionEditor.loadFailed.description: Error in the edit page's section editor when the open section's results could not be read. {error} is why: the server's error text, shown as is, or, for an error the edit page raises itself, that error's own message in the user's language.

editScreen.sectionEditor.loadingSection.description: Shown beside a spinner in the edit page's section editor while the open section's results are read.

editScreen.sectionEditor.noGeometry.defaultMessage: No field geometry available for this baseline — bounding-box highlighting is disabled.
editScreen.sectionEditor.noGeometry.description: Note under the page images of the edit page's section editor when the open section's results hold no explainability_info, so no field can be highlighted on the page images.

editScreen.sectionEditor.noValues.empty.defaultMessage: This section has an empty result: extraction ran but produced no fields.
editScreen.sectionEditor.noValues.empty.description: Text of the note in the edit page's section editor when the open section's results hold an empty inference_result.

editScreen.sectionEditor.noValues.header.defaultMessage: No field values for this section
editScreen.sectionEditor.noValues.header.description: Heading of the note in the Visual Editor tab of the edit page's section editor when the open section's results hold no field.

editScreen.sectionEditor.noValues.missin.defaultMessage: This section has no inference_result at all.
editScreen.sectionEditor.noValues.missin.description: Text of the note in the edit page's section editor when the open section's results hold no inference_result. inference_result is the results' JSON key, kept as is.

editScreen.sectionEditor.renderingPages.description: Shown beside a spinner in the edit page's section editor while the document's page images load.

editScreen.sectionEditor.saveFailed.description: Error in the edit page's section editor when the open section could not be saved. {error} is why: the server's error text, shown as is, or, for an error the edit page raises itself, that error's own message in the user's language.

editScreen.sectionEditor.sectionAriaLabe.description: Screen-reader name of the Section menu in the header of the edit page's section editor. {section} is the open section's name, as the menu shows it.

editScreen.sectionEditor.sectionFallback.description: Text of the Section menu's button in the header of the edit page's section editor when the document lists no section.

editScreen.sectionEditor.sectionTab.description: A section's name in the Section menu of the edit page's section editor, and on the menu's button. {sectionId} is the section's id and {documentClass} its document class, as the document holds them.

editScreen.sectionEditor.sectionTabNoCla.description: A section's name in the Section menu of the edit page's section editor, and on the menu's button, for a section with no document class. {sectionId} is the section's id.

editScreen.sectionEditor.showEvaluation.description: Toggle in the header of the edit page's section editor that compares every field with the document's evaluation baseline.

editScreen.sectionEditor.switchDiscardCo.defaultMessage: You have unsaved ground truth changes. Discard them and switch sections?
editScreen.sectionEditor.switchDiscardCo.description: Confirmation the browser shows when the user picks another section in the Section menu of the edit page's section editor with unsaved edits.

editScreen.sectionEditor.tab.json.description: Tab of the edit page's section editor that shows the open section's results as raw JSON.

editScreen.sectionEditor.tab.visual.description: Tab of the edit page's section editor that shows the open section's fields as a form.

editScreen.sectionEditor.unsavedChanges.defaultMessage: You have unsaved changes. Leave this document and discard them?
editScreen.sectionEditor.unsavedChanges.description: Confirmation the browser shows when the user follows a link in the app away from the edit page with unsaved edits in its section editor.

editScreen.shared.assignedTo.description: Why an action of the edit page, such as Process Changes or Edit Page Grouping, is unavailable: the item is assigned to another user. {assignee} is that user's e-mail address.

editScreen.shared.backToDocuments.description: Link after the edit page's or the document page's message about a missing or unreadable document, back to the Documents list.

editScreen.shared.backToTasks.description: Link after the edit page's message about a missing or unreadable document, back to Home › Tasks, for a user whose only role is Annotator.

editScreen.shared.claimed.defaultMessage: Claimed {name}. It is in Home › Tasks.
editScreen.shared.claimed.description: Notice after Claim on the edit page assigned the item to the user. {name} is the file name of the item's document; Home › Tasks is the page that lists the user's work, named by its breadcrumb trail.

editScreen.shared.couldNotOpenDocument.description: Heading of the error the edit page or the document page shows when its document could not be read.

editScreen.shared.documentCouldNotLoad.defaultMessage: The document could not be loaded.
editScreen.shared.documentCouldNotLoad.description: Fallback text of the error the edit page or the document page shows when its document could not be read: used when the server gave no reason.

editScreen.shared.documentEditor.description: Title of the edit page's Document Editor panel.

editScreen.shared.documentNotFound.description: Heading of the warning the edit page or the document page shows when its document no longer exists.

editScreen.shared.history.description: Item of the edit page's Reports menu, and the title of the dialog it opens, which lists the open section's field edits and the item's review activity.

editScreen.shared.loadingDocument.description: Shown beside a spinner while the edit page or the document page reads its document.

editScreen.shared.noChangesToSave.description: Why Save, in the edit page's action bar, is unavailable: the open section has no unsaved changes.

editScreen.shared.returnedToQueue.description: Notice shown as the edit page closes after Skip gave the item back to its queue. {name} is the file name of the item's document.

editScreen.shared.savingChanges.description: Why an action of the edit page's action bar, such as Save, Cancel, Refresh or Process Changes, is unavailable while the open section's changes are being saved.

editScreen.shared.working.description: Why the edit page's buttons, in its action bar and Edit Page Grouping, are unavailable while an action runs.

editScreen.states.documentFailed.body.description: Text of the error the edit page or the document page shows when its document could not be read. {error} is the reason the server gave, as it sent it, or a sentence saying the document could not be loaded; {backLink} is a link back to the Documents list or to Home › Tasks.

editScreen.states.documentMissing.body.description: Text of the warning the edit page or the document page shows when its document no longer exists. {backLink} is a link back to the Documents list or to Home › Tasks.

editScreen.states.itemFailed.action.description: Infinitive verb phrase placed inside the shared error sentence ("Failed to {action}: {error}", or the permission sentence) when the edit page could not read the review queue item of its document.

editScreen.states.itemFailed.header.description: Heading of the error the edit page shows when the review queue item of its document could not be read.

editScreen.states.notAMember.body.defaultMessage: Only the Annotators listed on this item's queue can open it. The queues that list you are in {queuesLink}.
editScreen.states.notAMember.body.description: Text of the warning the edit page shows to an Annotator who is not listed on the review queue of the item. {queuesLink} is a link to Home › Queues, the page of the queues that list the user.

editScreen.states.notAMember.header.defaultMessage: You can't open this review item
editScreen.states.notAMember.header.description: Heading of the warning the edit page shows to an Annotator who is not listed on the review queue of the item.

editScreen.states.notAMember.queuesLink.description: Text of the link to the page of the queues that list the user, named by its breadcrumb trail, inside the warning to an Annotator who cannot open a review item.

editScreen.toolsPanel.button.cancel.defaultMessage: Cancel leaves without finishing, asking first when there are unsaved edits.
editScreen.toolsPanel.button.cancel.description: Help panel note on the edit page's action bar. Cancel is the label of a button on the bar, in bold.

editScreen.toolsPanel.button.editView.defaultMessage: Edit | View switches between the Document Editor and the original file. Unsaved edits are kept while the file is shown.
editScreen.toolsPanel.button.editView.description: Help panel note on the edit page's action bar. Edit | View names the switch first in the bar by its two options, in bold. Document Editor is the title of the edit page's section editor.

editScreen.toolsPanel.button.processChan.defaultMessage: {processChanges} saves, then processes the changes: evaluation and summarization re-run, and OCR, classification and extraction are not repeated. It finishes a queue item. On a Test Studio document it also writes the labels as reviewed ground truth; when no draft version of the set is open, it asks first and opens the next version, leaving the current one as it is.
editScreen.toolsPanel.button.processChan.description: Help panel note on the edit page's action bar. {processChanges} is the label of the bar's Process Changes button, in bold. A queue item is a review queue item; a Test Studio document is a test-set item, and the set is its test set.

editScreen.toolsPanel.button.refresh.defaultMessage: Refresh reloads the document; with unsaved edits it asks first.
editScreen.toolsPanel.button.refresh.description: Help panel note on the edit page's action bar. Refresh is the label of a button on the bar, in bold.

editScreen.toolsPanel.button.save.defaultMessage: Save saves the open section without finishing. On a Test Studio document it keeps a draft, which opens no version.
editScreen.toolsPanel.button.save.description: Help panel note on the edit page's action bar. Save is the label of a button on the bar, in bold. A Test Studio document is a test-set item; a version is a version of its test set.

editScreen.toolsPanel.button.skip.defaultMessage: Skip (queue items) gives the item back to its queue with a reason. It is not finished, and saved work is kept.
editScreen.toolsPanel.button.skip.description: Help panel note on the edit page's action bar. Skip is the label of a button on the bar, in bold.

editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.buttons.defaultMessage: Its buttons, right of its title: Show Evaluation (where the document has an evaluation baseline), Section, Show Fields and Edit Page Grouping, which moves pages between sections and changes a section's class.
editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.buttons.description: Help panel note on the Document Editor, the edit page's section editor ("its" is the Document Editor's). Each bold text names a control in its header: the Show Evaluation toggle, the Section menu, the menu that chooses which fields show, and the Edit Page Grouping button.

editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.field.defaultMessage: Click a field to highlight it on the page. Show Fields narrows the list to confidence alerts or evaluation mismatches.
editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.field.description: Help panel note on the Document Editor, the edit page's section editor. Show Fields names the menu in its header that chooses which fields show.

editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.readOnly.defaultMessage: When you cannot edit, a notice at the top says why, with Claim or Take over where you may take the document.
editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.readOnly.description: Help panel note on the notice at the top of the edit page when its fields are read-only. Claim and Take over are the labels of buttons that come with that notice.

editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.reviewReaso.defaultMessage: A queue item's Review Reason lists why it is in review, worst first. Choose a reason, or {nextAlert}, to move to its field.
editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.reviewReaso.description: Help panel note on the Review Reason of a review queue item, the panel above the editor that lists why the item is in review. {nextAlert}, in bold, is the label of that panel's Next alert button, which moves to the next field with a confidence alert.

editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.section.defaultMessage: Choose a section from the Section list. The page image stays in view while you scroll the fields.
editScreen.toolsPanel.editor.section.description: Help panel note on the Document Editor, the edit page's section editor. The Section list is the menu in its header that opens a section.

editScreen.toolsPanel.heading.buttons.description: Sub-heading in the edit page's help panel, above the notes on the controls of the page's action bar.

editScreen.toolsPanel.heading.documentEd.description: Sub-heading in the edit page's help panel, above the notes on the section editor. Document Editor is the section editor's title.

editScreen.toolsPanel.heading.moreAction.description: Sub-heading in the edit page's help panel, above the notes on the More Actions menu of the action bar.

editScreen.toolsPanel.heading.reports.description: Sub-heading in the edit page's help panel, above the notes on the Reports menu of the action bar.

editScreen.toolsPanel.intro.defaultMessage: Correct a document's extracted values, page by page and section by section. The same screen opens from the document page, a queue item and a Test Studio document; it shows only the actions that apply.
editScreen.toolsPanel.intro.description: Opening paragraph of the edit page's help panel. The edit page opens from the document page, from a queue item (a review queue item) and from a Test Studio document (a test-set item).

editScreen.toolsPanel.link.humanReview.description: Label of a "Learn more" link in the edit page's help panel, to the Human review documentation page.

editScreen.toolsPanel.link.reviewQueues.description: Label of a "Learn more" link in the edit page's help panel, to the Review queues documentation page.

editScreen.toolsPanel.link.testStudio.description: Label of a "Learn more" link in the edit page's help panel, to the Test Studio documentation page. Test Studio is a product area name.

editScreen.toolsPanel.menuNote.defaultMessage: A menu item that does not apply yet stays in its menu, disabled; hover it to see why.
editScreen.toolsPanel.menuNote.description: Paragraph of the edit page's help panel, below the notes on the Reports and More Actions menus: why a menu item can be disabled.

editScreen.toolsPanel.moreActions.baseli.defaultMessage: Use As Evaluation Baseline (Admin and Author): copy a finished document's results into the evaluation baseline.
editScreen.toolsPanel.moreActions.baseli.description: Help panel note on the More Actions menu of the edit page's action bar. Use As Evaluation Baseline is the label of a menu item, in bold; Admin and Author are user roles.

editScreen.toolsPanel.report.history.defaultMessage: History: every saved field edit, and who worked the item.
editScreen.toolsPanel.report.history.description: Help panel note on the Reports menu of the edit page's action bar. History is the label of a menu item, in bold.

editScreen.toolsPanel.report.processing.defaultMessage: Processing Report: how the open section was extracted.
editScreen.toolsPanel.report.processing.description: Help panel note on the Reports menu of the edit page's action bar. Processing Report is the label of a menu item, in bold.

editScreen.toolsPanel.report.summary.defaultMessage: Summary: the document's summary, once it is finished.
editScreen.toolsPanel.report.summary.description: Help panel note on the Reports menu of the edit page's action bar. Summary is the label of a menu item, in bold.

editScreen.toolsPanel.title.description: Title of the edit page's help panel.

guidedTour.i18n.closeAnnotation.description: Screen-reader label of the marker of the current guided tour step while its popover is open; clicking it closes the popover.

guidedTour.i18n.dismiss.description: Screen-reader label of the close (X) button of a guided tour step, which exits the tour.

guidedTour.i18n.finish.description: Button of the last guided tour step that ends the tour.

guidedTour.i18n.next.description: Button of a guided tour step that moves to the next step.

guidedTour.i18n.openAnnotation.description: Screen-reader label of the marker of a guided tour step while its popover is closed; clicking it opens the popover.

guidedTour.i18n.previous.description: Button of a guided tour step that moves back to the previous step.

guidedTour.i18n.stepCounter.description: Step counter in the footer of a guided tour step. {stepNumber} is the 1-based number of the current step, {totalStepCount} the number of steps in the tour.

guidedTour.i18n.taskTitle.description: Header of a guided tour step. {taskNumber} is the 1-based number of the task, {taskTitle} its title (guidedTour.task.findYourWay).

guidedTour.step.agentChat.content.defaultMessage: Chat with the IDP assistant for help with analytics, errors, and questions about your documents and the system.
guidedTour.step.agentChat.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Agent Chat entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.agentChat.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Agent Chat entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.capacityPlanning.content.defaultMessage: Analyze throughput, predict resource needs, and get AWS service-quota recommendations for your workload.
guidedTour.step.capacityPlanning.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Capacity Planning entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.capacityPlanning.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Capacity Planning entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.configuration.content.defaultMessage: Review, edit, and activate configuration profiles — the document classes and fields IDP extracts.
guidedTour.step.configuration.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the configuration entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.configuration.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the configuration entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.customModels.content.defaultMessage: Fine-tune specialized classification models on your own document types for higher accuracy.
guidedTour.step.customModels.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Custom Models entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.customModels.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Custom Models entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.discovery.content.defaultMessage: Infer document classes and a schema automatically from a set of example documents.
guidedTour.step.discovery.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Discovery entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.discovery.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Discovery entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.documents.content.defaultMessage: Your processed documents live here — each with status, extracted fields, and confidence scores.
guidedTour.step.documents.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Documents entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.documents.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Documents entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.extensions.content.defaultMessage: IDP is extensible. Browse and install optional add-ons here — this list grows as new extensions become available, so capabilities can be added without redeploying.
guidedTour.step.extensions.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Extensions entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.extensions.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Extensions entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.getStarted.content.defaultMessage: Open the Quick Start assistant any time to set up a configuration or ask questions. Click Finish to open it now.
guidedTour.step.getStarted.content.description: Text of the last guided tour step, which points at the Quick Start assistant button. "Finish" is the label of the button that ends the tour (guidedTour.i18n.finish).

guidedTour.step.getStarted.title.description: Title of the last guided tour step, which points at the Quick Start assistant button.

guidedTour.step.knowledgeBase.content.defaultMessage: Ask natural-language questions about your processed documents using the document knowledge base.
guidedTour.step.knowledgeBase.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the document Knowledge Base entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.knowledgeBase.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the document Knowledge Base entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.pricing.content.defaultMessage: Review and adjust the per-service pricing used for document cost estimates.
guidedTour.step.pricing.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the pricing entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.pricing.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the pricing entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.testExecutions.content.defaultMessage: Run a configuration against a test set and review accuracy and confidence results here.
guidedTour.step.testExecutions.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Test executions entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.testExecutions.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Test executions entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.testSets.content.defaultMessage: Manage labeled test sets to measure extraction accuracy.
guidedTour.step.testSets.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Test sets entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.testSets.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Test sets entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.upload.content.defaultMessage: Upload one or more documents to run them through your active configuration.
guidedTour.step.upload.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the Upload documents entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.upload.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the Upload documents entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.step.userManagement.content.defaultMessage: Manage users and their roles (Admin, Author, Reviewer, Viewer) for the console.
guidedTour.step.userManagement.content.description: Text of the guided tour step that points at the User Management entry of the side navigation. The role names in parentheses are the console roles.

guidedTour.step.userManagement.title.description: Title of the guided tour step that points at the User Management entry of the side navigation.

guidedTour.task.findYourWay.description: Title of the single task of the guided tour, which walks through the side navigation. Shown in the header of every tour step.

guidedTour.tutorial.completed.description: Text shown when the guided tour is completed on a deployment where the Quick Start assistant is turned off.

guidedTour.tutorial.completedWithQuickSt.defaultMessage: That's the tour! Open the Quick Start assistant any time to build a configuration or get help.
guidedTour.tutorial.completedWithQuickSt.description: Text shown when the guided tour is completed on a deployment where the Quick Start assistant is enabled. "Quick Start" is the name of the assistant.

guidedTour.tutorial.description.defaultMessage: A quick walkthrough of the main areas of the console.
guidedTour.tutorial.description.description: One-sentence description of the guided tour, shown under its title.

guidedTour.tutorial.title.description: Title of the guided tour of the console. "GenAI IDP" is the product name and may stay as it is in the translation.

helpPanel.documentDetails.actionBar.description: Sub-heading above the bullets about the bar of buttons at the top of the document page.

helpPanel.documentDetails.barButtons.defaultMessage: Refresh the page, Troubleshoot what went wrong, and Edit the document's extracted values.
helpPanel.documentDetails.barButtons.description: Help panel bullet about the action bar; each bold word is a button label on the bar.

helpPanel.documentDetails.barMoreActions.defaultMessage: More Actions: Edit Page Grouping, Re-extract Sections, Edit Page Text, Reset Page Class, Use As Evaluation Baseline, Skip All Reviews; then the downloads (the document's outputs as a ZIP); then Reprocess, Abort and Delete.
helpPanel.documentDetails.barMoreActions.description: Help panel bullet about the action bar; the bold text and the action names match the More Actions menu.

helpPanel.documentDetails.barReports.defaultMessage: Reports: the Summary, Evaluation Report, Rule Validation Summary, Estimated Cost and Processing Flow, each in a dialog.
helpPanel.documentDetails.barReports.description: Help panel bullet about the action bar; the bold text and the report names match the Reports menu.

helpPanel.documentDetails.barSwitch.defaultMessage: Details | Source switches between the page's panels and the original file.
helpPanel.documentDetails.barSwitch.description: Help panel bullet about the action bar; the bold text names the two-way switch as the bar labels it.

helpPanel.documentDetails.docsAssessment.description: Documentation link in the document page help panel: the page about confidence assessment.

helpPanel.documentDetails.docsClassifica.description: Documentation link in the document page help panel: the page about document classification.

helpPanel.documentDetails.docsExtraction.description: Documentation link in the document page help panel: the page about field extraction.

helpPanel.documentDetails.docsHumanRevie.description: Documentation link in the document page help panel: the page about human review of documents.

helpPanel.documentDetails.docsWebUi.description: Documentation link in the document page help panel: the page about the web interface.

helpPanel.documentDetails.intro.defaultMessage: Inspect a document's processing results, and act on it from one bar at the top of the page.
helpPanel.documentDetails.intro.description: First sentence of the document page help panel.

helpPanel.documentDetails.learnMore.description: Heading of the documentation links at the bottom of the document page help panel.

helpPanel.documentDetails.onThePage.description: Sub-heading above the bullets about the panels of the document page.

helpPanel.documentDetails.pageColumns.defaultMessage: The ⚙ icon on each table chooses which columns it shows
helpPanel.documentDetails.pageColumns.description: Help panel bullet about the column preferences; ⚙ is the settings icon and stays as it is.

helpPanel.documentDetails.pageFields.description: Help panel bullet about the Document Details panel of the page.

helpPanel.documentDetails.pagePages.defaultMessage: Each page's class, confidence and thumbnail; its ⋮ menu opens the page text
helpPanel.documentDetails.pagePages.description: Help panel bullet about the pages table; ⋮ is the row menu icon and stays as it is.

helpPanel.documentDetails.pageSections.defaultMessage: Each section's class, pages and status; its ⋮ menu opens or downloads its data
helpPanel.documentDetails.pageSections.description: Help panel bullet about the sections table; ⋮ is the row menu icon and stays as it is.

helpPanel.documentDetails.pageVersions.defaultMessage: Version History, to view (from each row's ⋮ menu) or compare past processing runs, and Chat with the document
helpPanel.documentDetails.pageVersions.description: Help panel bullet about the Version History and Chat panels; ⋮ is the row menu icon and stays as it is.

helpPanel.documentDetails.title.description: Heading of the help panel of a document page.

helpPanel.documentDetails.unavailableAct.defaultMessage: Actions your role can't perform are not shown. One that doesn't apply now, for example while you view a past version, stays in place, disabled; hover it to see why.
helpPanel.documentDetails.unavailableAct.description: Paragraph under the action bar bullets: why an action can be missing or disabled.

helpPanel.documents.docsCircuitBreaker.description: Documentation link in the Documents help panel: the page about the circuit breaker that pauses processing.

helpPanel.documents.docsHumanReview.description: Documentation link in the Documents help panel: the page about human review of documents.

helpPanel.documents.docsMonitoring.description: Documentation link in the Documents help panel: the page about monitoring.

helpPanel.documents.docsWebUi.description: Documentation link in the Documents help panel: the page about the web interface.

helpPanel.documents.feature1.defaultMessage: View document processing status, classification, and confidence scores
helpPanel.documents.feature1.description: First item of the feature list in the Documents help panel.

helpPanel.documents.feature2.defaultMessage: Filter by date range, status, document type, or any field using the search bar
helpPanel.documents.feature2.description: Second item of the feature list in the Documents help panel.

helpPanel.documents.feature3.defaultMessage: Select documents to reprocess, delete, or abort active workflows
helpPanel.documents.feature3.description: Third item of the feature list in the Documents help panel.

helpPanel.documents.feature4.defaultMessage: Claim or release documents for human review
helpPanel.documents.feature4.description: Fourth item of the feature list in the Documents help panel.
