reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.draftSa.description: Event in a review item's history: the reviewer saved their edits as a draft.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.finaliz.description: Event in a review item's history: applying the review's result could not start and will be tried again.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.forceRe.description: Event in a review item's history: an Admin took the item away from its Annotator and put it back in its queue.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.moved.description: Event in a review item's history: an Admin moved the item to another queue.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.reassig.description: Event in a review item's history: an Admin assigned the item to another Annotator.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.reclaim.description: Event in a review item's history: an Annotator claimed the item after someone else's claim on it expired.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.rejecte.description: Event in a review item's history: the reviewer rejected the document.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.release.description: Event in a review item's history: its Annotator gave the item back to its queue unfinished (Skip).

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.removed.description: Event in a review item's history: an Admin took the item out of review, so the document kept its machine results.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.section.description: Event in a document's review history: the review of one of its sections was completed.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.sentToR.description: Event in a review item's history: someone sent the finished document to a review queue by hand.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.skipped.description: Event in a review item's history: its review was finished without checking, with Skip All Reviews. Skip All Reviews names an action of the app.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.superse.description: Event in a review item's history: a newer review of the same document replaced this one.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.takenOv.description: Event in a review item's history: an Admin took over the item from the Annotator it was assigned to.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.event.withdra.description: Event in a review item's history: the item left review without a result, for example because its document was processed again.

reviewQueues.reviewHistory.title.description: Header of the dialog listing a review item's history. {count} is the number of events.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.assign.description: Row menu item of a waiting review item that assigns it to an Annotator (opens a dialog).

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.assignFai.defaultMessage: Couldn't assign {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}: {failures}
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.assignFai.description: Error after an Admin assigned review items and some failed. {count} is how many failed; {failures} lists each one as its file name followed by the reason in parentheses, separated by semicolons.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.assignIte.description: Action phrase completing an API error sentence ("Failed to …: <error>" / "You do not have permission to …") when one review item cannot be assigned; "it" is the item.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.assigned.defaultMessage: Assigned {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to {email}.
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.assigned.description: Notice after an Admin assigned review items. {count} is how many were assigned and {email} is the Annotator's e-mail address.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.group.description: Group heading in a review item's row menu on a queue's page, holding the actions only an Admin has. Admin is a user role.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.loadAnnot.description: Action phrase completing an API error sentence ("Failed to …: <error>" / "You do not have permission to …") when the Annotators an Admin can assign items to cannot be loaded. Annotator is a user role.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.move.description: Row menu item of a review item that moves it to another review queue (opens a dialog).

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.moveFaile.defaultMessage: Couldn't move {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}: {failures}
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.moveFaile.description: Error after an Admin moved review items to another queue and some failed. {count} is how many failed; {failures} lists each one as its file name followed by the reason in parentheses, separated by semicolons.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.moveItemA.description: Action phrase completing an API error sentence ("Failed to …: <error>" / "You do not have permission to …") when one review item cannot be moved to another queue; "it" is the item.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.moved.defaultMessage: Moved {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to {queue}.
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.moved.description: Notice after an Admin moved review items to another queue. {count} is how many and {queue} is the queue's name, as stored.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.noOtherQu.description: Why the Move to another queue… item of a review item's row menu is disabled: there is no other review queue.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.notAssign.description: Why the Unassign item of a review item's row menu is disabled.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.notWaitin.defaultMessage: This item is not waiting for review
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.notWaitin.description: Why the Assign… or Remove from queue… item of a review item's row menu is disabled: the item is neither waiting nor assigned.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.reassign.description: Row menu item of an assigned review item that assigns it to another Annotator (opens a dialog).

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.remove.description: Row menu item of a review item that takes it out of review (opens a dialog).

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.removeFai.defaultMessage: Couldn't remove {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}: {failures}
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.removeFai.description: Error after an Admin removed review items from review and some failed. {count} is how many failed; {failures} lists each one as its file name followed by the reason in parentheses, separated by semicolons.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.removeIte.description: Action phrase completing an API error sentence ("Failed to …: <error>" / "You do not have permission to …") when one review item cannot be taken out of review; "it" is the item.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.removed.defaultMessage: Removed {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from review.
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.removed.description: Notice after an Admin took review items out of review. {count} is how many.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.unassign.description: Row menu item of an assigned review item that takes it back from its Annotator (opens a dialog).

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.unassignF.defaultMessage: Couldn't unassign {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}: {failures}
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.unassignF.description: Error after an Admin unassigned review items and some failed. {count} is how many failed; {failures} lists each one as its file name followed by the reason in parentheses, separated by semicolons.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.unassignI.description: Action phrase completing an API error sentence ("Failed to …: <error>" / "You do not have permission to …") when one review item cannot be taken back from its Annotator; "it" is the item.

reviewQueues.supervisorActions.unassigne.defaultMessage: Unassigned {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}.
reviewQueues.supervisorActions.unassigne.description: Notice after an Admin took review items back from their Annotators. {count} is how many.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.cancel.description: Button of the Unassign, Move to another queue and Remove from queue dialogs that closes the dialog without acting.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.chooseQueu.description: Placeholder of the Target queue field of the Move to another queue dialog.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.move.description: Button of the Move to another queue dialog that moves the items to the chosen queue.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.moveMany.defaultMessage: Move {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to another queue. An assignment is removed; drafts are kept.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.moveMany.description: Body of the Move to another queue dialog for several items. {count} is how many.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.moveOne.defaultMessage: Move {document} to another queue. An assignment is removed; drafts are kept.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.moveOne.description: Body of the Move to another queue dialog for one item. {document} is its file name.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.moveTitle.description: Title of the dialog that moves review items to another review queue.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.noOtherQue.defaultMessage: There is no other queue to move to.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.noOtherQue.description: Shown in the Target queue list of the Move to another queue dialog when there is no other review queue.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.note.description: Label of the Remove from queue dialog's field for an optional note about why the items are removed.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.noteDescri.defaultMessage: Optional. Kept in the item's history.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.noteDescri.description: Description of the Note field of the Remove from queue dialog.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.queueRequi.description: Error under the Target queue field of the Move to another queue dialog when the user moves without choosing one.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.remove.description: Button of the Remove from queue dialog that takes the items out of review.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.removeMany.defaultMessage: Remove {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from review. The document completes with its machine results and leaves review. Draft corrections are not applied, and an assigned Annotator is told.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.removeMany.description: Body of the Remove from queue dialog for several items. {count} is how many.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.removeOne.defaultMessage: Remove {document} from review. The document completes with its machine results and leaves review. Draft corrections are not applied, and an assigned Annotator is told.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.removeOne.description: Body of the Remove from queue dialog for one item. {document} is its file name.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.removeTitl.description: Title of the dialog that takes review items out of review.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.targetQueu.description: Label of the Move to another queue dialog's field that chooses the review queue to move the items to.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.unassign.description: Title of the dialog that takes review items back from their Annotators, and its button that does it. The items stay in their queue, assigned to no one.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.unassignMa.defaultMessage: Take {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} back from their Annotators. They stay in their queue, unassigned; drafts are kept and the Annotators are told.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.unassignMa.description: Body of the Unassign dialog for several items. {count} is how many.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.unassignOn.defaultMessage: Take {document} back from {annotator}. It stays in {queue}, unassigned; the draft is kept and the Annotator is told.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.unassignOn.description: Body of the Unassign dialog for one item. {document} is its file name, {annotator} the e-mail address of the Annotator it is assigned to, and {queue} the id of its review queue.

reviewQueues.supervisorModals.unassignOn.defaultMessage: Take {document} back from its Annotator. It stays in {queue}, unassigned; the draft is kept and the Annotator is told.
reviewQueues.supervisorModals.unassignOn.description: Body of the Unassign dialog for one item whose Annotator is not known. {document} is its file name and {queue} the id of its review queue.

reviewQueues.taskContext.confidence.description: Popover text on a low-confidence review reason. {score} is the extracted value's confidence and {threshold} the threshold it fell below, both already formatted with two decimals.

reviewQueues.taskContext.escalated.description: Header of the info alert on an escalated review item; the alert's text is the escalation note, as written.

reviewQueues.taskContext.extractionFaile.defaultMessage: Extraction failed for this section, so it has no extracted data to check.
reviewQueues.taskContext.extractionFaile.description: Popover text on an "Extraction failed" review reason: the section was held for review because its extraction did not succeed (for example, a content filter withheld the model reply), not because of a field confidence.

reviewQueues.taskContext.field.description: Popover line on a review reason chip: the field it is about. {field} is the field's name or path in the extracted data.

reviewQueues.taskContext.missingValue.defaultMessage: No extracted value; the class schema requires this field.
reviewQueues.taskContext.missingValue.description: Popover text on a Missing required review reason: extraction left a field empty that the document class schema requires.

reviewQueues.taskContext.moreAlerts.defaultMessage: +{count, plural, one {# more alert} other {# more alerts}}
reviewQueues.taskContext.moreAlerts.description: After the first review reason chips: how many more reasons the item has. A button that shows the rest, or a grey badge when the rest are not listed. {count} is at least 1.

reviewQueues.taskContext.onlyLowest.defaultMessage: Only the {count} lowest-confidence alerts are listed.
reviewQueues.taskContext.onlyLowest.description: Popover on the grey badge counting the review reasons that are not listed: only the worst ones are kept. {count} is how many are listed.

reviewQueues.taskContext.section.description: Popover line on a review reason chip: the document section it belongs to. {sectionId} is the section's id, usually a number.

reviewQueues.taskContext.sentBy.description: Body of the Sent to review alert. {requestedBy} is the user (e-mail) who sent the document to review.

reviewQueues.taskContext.sentByWithNote.description: Body of the Sent to review alert when the sender left a note. {requestedBy} is the user (e-mail) who sent it; {note} is their free-text note.

reviewQueues.taskContext.sentToReview.description: Header of the info alert on a review task whose document was sent to review by hand. {reason} is the reason chosen when sending it.

reviewQueues.taskContext.showFewer.description: Button that collapses the review reason chips back to the first few.

reviewQueues.taskContext.showMoreAlerts.defaultMessage: Show {count, plural, one {# more alert} other {# more alerts}}
reviewQueues.taskContext.showMoreAlerts.description: Screen-reader label of the button that shows the rest of the review reason chips. {count} is at least 1.

reviewQueues.taskContext.title.description: Heading of the panel above the editor of a review item that lists why the document is in review, one chip per reason.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.annotators.defaultMessage: Annotators (Admin): each listed Annotator, with the documents assigned to them.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.annotators.description: Queue info panel, "On this page" item. Annotators is the title of a panel of the page, shown in bold; "(Admin)" says only Admins see it.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.assignmentExpiry.defaultMessage: An assignment does not expire. After the queue's time limit, the Annotator is reminded once.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.assignmentExpiry.description: Queue info panel, "Assignments" item. Annotator is a user role.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.assignmentsHeadi.description: Sub-heading in the Queue info panel, above the notes on how assignments work.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.documentsTable.defaultMessage: The documents table: sort by Annotator to see each person's work. Select documents to assign, unassign, move or claim them; open one to edit it.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.documentsTable.description: Queue info panel, "On this page" item. Annotator is the header of a column of the table, shown in bold.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.keyMetrics.defaultMessage: Key Metrics: pending, assigned and in-progress counts, and the queue's Annotators and priority.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.keyMetrics.description: Queue info panel, "On this page" item. Key Metrics is the title of a panel of the page, shown in bold.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.linkHumanReview.description: Label of a "Learn more" link to the Human review documentation page.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.linkReviewQueues.description: Label of a "Learn more" link to the Review queues documentation page.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.linkTestStudio.description: Label of a "Learn more" link to the Test Studio documentation page. Test Studio is a product area name.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.managementIntro.defaultMessage: Every review queue in one place: the Production queues documents are routed to, and one Test Studio queue per test set. The Production | Test Studio switch chooses which table is shown.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.managementIntro.description: Opening paragraph of the Review Management info panel. Production | Test Studio names the switch above the tables, in bold: its two options.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.managementTitle.description: Title of the info panel of Review Studio › Review Management (the review queues an Admin sets up).

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.onThisPage.description: Sub-heading in the Queue info panel, above the list of what the page shows and does.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.productionHeadin.description: Sub-heading in the Review Management info panel, above the notes on production queues.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.productionOpen.defaultMessage: Open a queue to assign its documents to Annotators, unassign them, move them or remove them from review.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.productionOpen.description: Review Management info panel, "Production queues" item. Annotator is a user role.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.productionRoutin.defaultMessage: A document whose fields raised confidence alerts goes to the Default queue, when HITL is enabled in its configuration.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.productionRoutin.description: Review Management info panel, "Production queues" item. Default is the name of a queue; HITL (human in the loop) is the name of a configuration setting.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.productionSettin.defaultMessage: Settings sets a queue's name, priority, time limit, eligible Annotators and Enabled switch. A saved change shows at once.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.productionSettin.description: Review Management info panel, "Production queues" item. Settings is the label of a menu item, shown in bold; Enabled is the label of a switch.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.queueIntro.defaultMessage: One queue's documents and the Annotators who work them.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.queueIntro.description: Opening paragraph of the Queue info panel. Annotator is a user role.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.queueProgress.defaultMessage: Queue Progress: on a Production queue, the documents assigned or in progress (a finished document leaves the queue); on a Test Studio queue, the documents completed.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.queueProgress.description: Queue info panel, "On this page" item. Queue Progress is the title of a panel of the page, shown in bold.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.queueTitle.description: Title of the info panel of a review queue's page, Production or Test Studio.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.skip.defaultMessage: Skip gives a document back to the queue, unassigned and not finished; its saved work is kept.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.skip.description: Queue info panel, "Assignments" item. Skip is the label of a button.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.testStudioAnnota.defaultMessage: List Annotators in its settings; they claim documents or an Admin assigns them.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.testStudioAnnota.description: Review Management info panel, "Test Studio queues" item. Annotator and Admin are user roles.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.testStudioHeadin.description: Sub-heading in the Review Management info panel, above the notes on Test Studio queues. Test Studio is a product area name.

reviewQueues.toolsPanel.testStudioSets.defaultMessage: Each test set is a queue: its documents are the labels to check before they become ground truth.
reviewQueues.toolsPanel.testStudioSets.description: Review Management info panel, "Test Studio queues" item.

reviewQueues.workItem.alerts.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# confidence alert} other {# confidence alerts}}
reviewQueues.workItem.alerts.description: Top reason column of Home › Tasks for a Test Studio document. {count} is the number of its fields below their confidence threshold.

reviewQueues.workItem.draftLabels.description: Top reason column of Home › Tasks for a Test Studio document that has no confidence alert but has labels for the Annotator to check and confirm.

reviewQueues.workItem.escalated.description: Queue column of a review work table for an escalated item. {queue} is the queue id, as an Admin named it.

reviewQueues.workItem.source.production.description: Source of a review work item or queue: a production review queue (as opposed to Test Studio). Shown as a badge in the Source column of Home › Tasks, Home › Queues and a queue page, and in the source filter.

reviewQueues.workItem.source.testSet.description: Source of a review work item or queue: a Test Studio test set being annotated. Shown as a badge in the Source column of Home › Tasks, Home › Queues and a queue page, and in the source filter. Test Studio is the name of the screen.

reviewQueues.workItem.state.assigned.description: State column of a review work table for an item an Annotator holds, and for every Test Studio document assigned to the reader.

reviewQueues.workItem.you.description: Annotator column of a review work table, and the end of a queue page's "Assigned to …" hint, for an item assigned to the reader.

reviewQueues.workItemActions.edit.description: Item of a review work table row's menu: opens the item's edit page, without changing who it is assigned to.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.assignment.a.description: Option of a review work table's assignment filter: every item, assigned or not.
Option of a review work table's assignment filter: items assigned to an Annotator.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.assignment.f.description: Screen-reader label of a review work table's filter on whether items are assigned.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.assignment.u.description: Option of a review work table's assignment filter: items no one is assigned to.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.actio.description: Column header of a review work table's row menus.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.age.description: Column header of a review work table: how long ago the item entered its queue or was assigned.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.docum.description: Column header of a review work table (Home › Tasks, a queue page): the document, as a link to its edit page.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.owner.description: Column header of a review work table: who the item is assigned to. Annotator is the name of a user role.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.prior.description: Column header of a review work table: the item's priority, a number.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.queue.description: Column header of a review work table: the review queue (or Test Studio test set) the item is in.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.reaso.description: Column header of a review work table: the main reason the item needs review, such as a field's low confidence.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.sourc.description: Column header of a review work table: whether the item comes from a production review queue or from Test Studio.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.column.state.description: Column header of a review work table: the item's review state, such as Waiting or Assigned.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.find.description: Placeholder and screen-reader label of a review work table's text filter.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.loading.description: Shown in a review work table while its items load.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.moreReasons.description: After an item's top reason in a review work table: how many more reasons it has. {count} is at least 1.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.openDocument.description: Screen-reader label of a review work table's document link, which opens its edit page. {objectKey} is the document's full name.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.rowActions.description: Screen-reader label of a review work table row's menu button. {name} is the document's file name.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.selection.al.defaultMessage: Select all items on this page
reviewQueues.workItemsTable.selection.al.description: Screen-reader label of a review work table's select-all checkbox.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.selection.gr.description: Screen-reader label of a review work table's selection checkboxes, as a group.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.selection.it.description: Screen-reader label of a review work table row's checkbox. {name} is the document's file name.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.source.all.description: Option of a review work table's source filter: items from production queues and from Test Studio.

reviewQueues.workItemsTable.source.filte.description: Screen-reader label of a review work table's filter on the items' source (production or Test Studio).

routes.auth.signOut.description: The one button of the /logout page, which signs the user out.

routes.myWork.jobCrumb.description: Last breadcrumb on the page of one bulk Skip All Reviews job, after Home › Jobs.

routes.requireRole.body.defaultMessage: Your role doesn't include this page.
routes.requireRole.body.description: Body of the notice shown in place of a page the user’s role does not include; followed by the link to the home page.

routes.requireRole.header.defaultMessage: You don't have access to this page
routes.requireRole.header.description: Header of the notice shown in place of a page the user’s role does not include.

routes.requireRole.homeLink.description: Link in the notice shown in place of a page the user’s role does not include; opens the user’s home page.

routes.reviewQueues.testSetCrumb.description: Breadcrumb of a test set’s queue page, after Review Management or Home › Queues. {name} is the test set’s name.

routes.session.errorBody.defaultMessage: You are signed in, but the app could not obtain AWS credentials for your session. This is usually temporary — retrying or reloading normally resolves it. If it persists, sign out and sign in again.
routes.session.errorBody.description: Body of the error notice shown when the app could not obtain AWS credentials after a valid sign-in.

routes.session.errorHeader.description: Header of the error notice shown when the app could not obtain AWS credentials after a valid sign-in.

routes.session.infoIconAriaLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the status icon of the no-role notice.

routes.session.loading.description: Text under the spinner shown after sign-in while the app waits for the AWS credentials of the session.

routes.session.noRoleBody.defaultMessage: Your sign-in worked, but your account has not been given a role yet, so there is nothing for you to view. Ask an administrator to grant you one — Admin, Author, Reviewer, Annotator or Viewer. If your organization signs you in through its own identity provider, the role comes from your group membership there rather than from this application. Reload this page once it has been granted.
routes.session.noRoleBody.description: Body of the notice shown to a signed-in user whose account is in no Cognito group. Admin, Author, Reviewer, Annotator and Viewer are the names of the application roles.

routes.session.noRoleHeader.defaultMessage: Your account has not been granted access yet
routes.session.noRoleHeader.description: Header of the notice shown to a signed-in user whose account is in no Cognito group, so no page can be shown.

routes.session.reloadPage.description: Button of the session error notice and of the no-role notice that reloads the browser page.

routes.session.retry.description: Button of the session error notice that requests the credentials again.

routes.session.signOut.description: Button of the no-role notice that signs the user out.

routes.unauth.emailRequired.description: Validation error of the sign-up form when the e-mail field is left empty.

routes.unauth.federatedSignIn.description: Button above the sign-in form that signs in through the external identity provider. {provider} is its configured name.

routes.unauth.header.defaultMessage: Welcome to GenAI Intelligent Document Processing!
routes.unauth.header.description: Heading above the sign-in form. "GenAI Intelligent Document Processing" is the product name and may stay as it is in the translation.

routes.unauth.orUsername.description: Separator between the external identity provider button and the username and password form below it.

routes.unauth.redirecting.description: Text shown instead of the sign-in form while the browser is sent to the external identity provider. {provider} is its configured name.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.defaultMessage: Only documents that finished processing can be added to a test set.
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.description: Body of the notice about selected documents that are left out.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# selected document is not included} other {# selected documents are not included}}
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.notComp.description: Header of a notice listing selected documents that are left out because they have not finished processing.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerH.defaultMessage: Add documents to a test set
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerH.description: Header of the add-to-test-set dialog opened from the Document List, before a test set is chosen.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerI.defaultMessage: Each selected document is copied into the test set together with any ground truth already saved for it. testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.pickerI.description: Introduction of the add-to-test-set dialog opened from the Document List, where the documents are already chosen.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.selecte.description: Header of the table listing the documents chosen on the Document List.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.defaultMessage: The documents are added to an existing test set. To start a new set, create it in Test Studio first.
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.description: Help text under the test set field in the add-to-test-set dialog.
Description of a test set option: how many documents the set already holds.
Label of the field that chooses which test set the selected documents are added to.
Placeholder of the test set field before one is chosen.
Why a test set option cannot be chosen. {status} is the test set status, such as UPDATING.

testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.defaultMessage: There are no test sets yet. Create one in Test Studio first.
testStudio.addProcessedDocuments.testSet.description: Shown in the test set field when no test set exists.
Error shown when the list of test sets fails to load. {error} is the error message from the server.
Shown in the test set field while the list of test sets loads.

testStudio.createTestSetWizard.noConfigu.defaultMessage: No configuration yet? <link>Discovery</link> infers classes and fields from example documents.
testStudio.createTestSetWizard.noConfigu.description: Hint under the configuration prerequisite of the create-test-set wizard, shown to a user who is not offered Quick Start. <link> wraps a link to the Discovery page.

testStudio.createTestSetWizard.noConfigu.defaultMessage: No configuration yet? <link>Discovery</link> infers classes and fields from example documents, or open Quick Start from the side navigation to describe them in your own words.
testStudio.createTestSetWizard.noConfigu.description: Hint under the configuration prerequisite of the create-test-set wizard, shown to a user who is offered Quick Start. <link> wraps a link to the Discovery page.

testStudio.itemEdit.regroupPending.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable: a page grouping was just saved and the document editor is still re-reading the saved sections.

testStudio.itemEdit.regroupRereadFailed.defaultMessage: The saved grouping could not be re-read. Choose Refresh to load it.
testStudio.itemEdit.regroupRereadFailed.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable: re-reading the sections after a page grouping was saved failed. Refresh is a button on the same page.

testStudio.modifiedAfter.customTimeIsUtc.defaultMessage: Date and time are in UTC.
testStudio.modifiedAfter.customTimeIsUtc.description: Help text beside the custom date and time of the "Modified after" filter when picking files for a test set: the entered date and time are read as UTC, not as the browser's local time.

testStudio.modifiedAfter.invalidCustomDa.defaultMessage: Enter a real date and a time as HH:mm:ss.
testStudio.modifiedAfter.invalidCustomDa.description: Error beside the custom date and time of the "Modified after" filter when they are not a real date and time, for example 30 February or 24:00:00. Keep HH:mm:ss as it is.

testStudio.patternPreview.alreadyInSet.description: Part of the Check Files result: matching files the set already holds, which the add leaves as they are.

testStudio.patternPreview.archivesLeftOu.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# .zip archive} other {# .zip archives}} left out
testStudio.patternPreview.archivesLeftOu.description: Part of the Check Files result: matching .zip files, which the add does not copy.

testStudio.patternPreview.filesToAdd.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to add
testStudio.patternPreview.filesToAdd.description: Test Studio Check Files result: how many files matching the pattern the add will copy into the set.

testStudio.patternPreview.leftOutNote.description: Shown after the Check Files count. {leftOut} lists the matching files the add leaves out, e.g. "1 already in the set".

testStudio.patternPreview.noneToAdd.defaultMessage: None of the {count, plural, one {# matching file} other {# matching files}} would be added ({leftOut}).
testStudio.patternPreview.noneToAdd.description: Warning when Check Files matched files but the add would copy none of them. {leftOut} says why, e.g. "1 already in the set".

testStudio.results.aurocIncludingEmpty.description: Metric name: AUROC computed over all fields, including fields the extractor returned empty.

testStudio.results.confidencePrefix.description: Prefix before a confidence calibration metric name in the test run breakdown table.

testStudio.results.emptyPredictions.description: Metric name: fields the extractor returned no value for.

testStudio.results.emptyPredictionsValue.description: {count} is the number of empty predictions; {wrong} is how many of them had a value in the ground truth.
{count} is the number of empty predictions; {wrong} is how many of them were wrong; {auroc} is the formatted AUROC over those fields alone.

testStudio.results.olderSectionsNotScore.defaultMessage: {sections, plural, one {# older section not scored} other {# older sections not scored}}
testStudio.results.olderSectionsNotScore.description: Appended to the empty-predictions value when some sections were evaluated before this measure existed.

testStudio.testSets.delete.notDeleted.description: Error shown on the Test Sets page when none of the selected test sets was deleted. {reason} is the server’s message.

testStudio.testSets.delete.outcomeUnknow.defaultMessage: Some test sets may not have been deleted, and the list could not be reloaded to show which: {reason}
testStudio.testSets.delete.outcomeUnknow.description: Error shown on the Test Sets page when a delete of test sets was partly refused or failed and the list then failed to reload. {reason} is the server’s message from the delete.

testStudio.testSets.delete.partlyDeleted.defaultMessage: Deleted {deleted} of {total, plural, one {# test set} other {# test sets}}. {reason}
testStudio.testSets.delete.partlyDeleted.description: Error shown on the Test Sets page when a delete of several test sets removed some and not others. {reason} is the server’s message naming each test set that was refused (busy) or failed, and why.

topNavigation.feedback.ariaLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the feedback menu button in the top navigation.

topNavigation.feedback.reportBug.description: Feedback menu item that opens a pre-filled GitHub bug report in a new tab.

topNavigation.feedback.requestFeature.description: Feedback menu item that opens a pre-filled GitHub feature request in a new tab.

topNavigation.feedback.text.description: Text and tooltip of the feedback menu button in the top navigation, which lists the GitHub feedback links.

topNavigation.feedback.viewIssues.description: Feedback menu item that opens the list of GitHub issues of the project in a new tab.

topNavigation.identity.defaultTitle.description: Title in the top navigation bar when the deployment sets no console title of its own. "AWS IDP Accelerator" is the product name and may stay as it is in the translation.

topNavigation.overflowMenuTriggerText.description: Text of the button that opens the collapsed utilities when the top navigation is too narrow to show them all.

topNavigation.role.admin.description: Role label of a user in the Admin group, shown next to the name in the user menu of the top navigation.

topNavigation.role.annotator.description: Role label of a user in the Annotator group, shown next to the name in the user menu of the top navigation.

topNavigation.role.author.description: Role label of a user in the Author group, shown next to the name in the user menu of the top navigation.

topNavigation.role.reviewer.description: Role label of a user in the Reviewer group, shown next to the name in the user menu of the top navigation.

topNavigation.role.viewer.description: Role label of a user in the Viewer group, shown next to the name in the user menu of the top navigation.

topNavigation.signOutModal.body.description: Question asked in the body of the sign-out confirmation dialog.

topNavigation.signOutModal.cancel.description: Button of the sign-out confirmation dialog that closes it without signing out.

topNavigation.signOutModal.closeAriaLabe.description: Screen-reader label of the close (X) button of the sign-out confirmation dialog.

topNavigation.signOutModal.confirm.description: Primary button of the sign-out confirmation dialog, which signs the user out.

topNavigation.signOutModal.header.description: Title of the sign-out confirmation dialog.

topNavigation.user.fallback.description: Stands in for the name in the user menu of the top navigation when the signed-in user has neither a display name nor a username.

topNavigation.user.signOut.description: The item of the user menu in the top navigation that opens the sign-out confirmation dialog.

topNavigation.user.withRole.description: Text of the user menu button in the top navigation. {user} is the display name or username, {role} the role label (Admin, Author, Reviewer, Viewer or Annotator).

welcome.page.description.defaultMessage: Get a working configuration in minutes — or jump straight into the console.
welcome.page.description.description: Subtitle under the heading of the Welcome page.

welcome.page.dismiss.description: Link at the bottom of the Welcome page that hides the page on later visits and opens the document list.

welcome.page.enterConsole.description: Button of the Welcome page that opens the document list. "IDP" is the product abbreviation and may stay as it is in the translation.

welcome.page.goToQueue.description: Button of the Welcome page for a user who can only annotate; it opens their task queue.

welcome.page.haveConfigHint.defaultMessage: Already have a config? Go to Configuration > View/Edit Configuration to review or update it.
welcome.page.haveConfigHint.description: Second hint on the Welcome page. The <b> phrase is the question that opens the hint, shown in bold. The <link> phrase is the path to the configuration editor in the side navigation (section > page, with the same names) and opens it.

welcome.page.helpHeading.description: Heading above the hints on the Welcome page.

welcome.page.noConfigurationDiscovery.defaultMessage: No configuration yet? Discovery infers classes and fields from example documents.
welcome.page.noConfigurationDiscovery.description: First hint on the Welcome page, for a user who can create a configuration but is not offered Quick Start. The <b> phrase is the question that opens the hint, shown in bold. The <link> phrase is the name of the Discovery page in the side navigation and opens it.

welcome.page.noConfigurationQuickStart.defaultMessage: No configuration yet? Open Quick Start to describe your document type or upload an example. Once you approve, it creates and activates a configuration for you. In the console, Quick Start is also at the top of the side navigation. Or let Discovery infer classes and fields from example documents.
welcome.page.noConfigurationQuickStart.description: First hint on the Welcome page, for a user offered Quick Start. The <b> phrase is the question that opens the hint, shown in bold. The <quickStart> phrase is the name of the Quick Start feature (the same as the Quick Start button) and opens it. The <discovery> phrase is the name of the Discovery page in the side navigation and opens it.

welcome.page.quickStart.description: Primary button of the Welcome page that opens the Quick Start chat, which builds a configuration from a description or an example document. The first hint names the same feature in its link.

welcome.page.takeTour.description: Button of the Welcome page that starts the guided tour of the console.

welcome.page.testDocumentHint.defaultMessage: Want to test a document? Head to Upload Documents to run one through your active configuration.
welcome.page.testDocumentHint.description: Third hint on the Welcome page. The <b> phrase is the question that opens the hint, shown in bold. The <link> phrase is the name of the Upload Documents page in the side navigation and opens it.

welcome.page.title.description: Heading of the Welcome page. "GenAI IDP" is the product name and may stay as it is in the translation.
